skills.summary:
How other games handle class skills, and what fits us: games that kids play on phones give each class a basic attack plus 2 active skills at the start, then add about one skill per milestone. In World // Zero a starter class has 2 skills plus an ultimate. AQW unlocks skills at class ranks 1/2/3/5. MapleStory has an NPC job instructor at Lv10. In Blox Fruits, moves on Z/X/C/V unlock as mastery grows. Arcane Odyssey starts you with one spell on Q and adds more through progress and scrolls. Dungeon Quest gives rare spells as drops. On phones, skill buttons sit in an arc in the jump-button zone. Roblox docs say to avoid the default-control corners, place buttons relative to the jump button, and make them at least about 9 mm. Under auto-battle, MapleStory M uses equipped skills in slot order.

Our repo today: one shared skill (Config.BasicSkill: MP20, 3 s cooldown, 12x a basic swing). The class only changes where it lands (on self or on the target) and which effect plays. There is no skill ID, no slots and no learning. The 'Release' remote takes no arguments, and the auto loop only knows that one skill. A learn-at-NPC / slot / server-check contract is already written in docs/art/skills_progression_2026-10-04.md but not built. Note that reference_lessons_2026-10-05.md:56 had pushed 'skill learning, slots and job advancement' to after launch; the user's new request reopens it.

Recommendation: 3 skills per class (Q kept + Z + X), 9 skills in total. Faction changes only the colour and adds the existing perks (Halo heal, Horns lifesteal); no separate skill sets per faction. Each skill gets a different shape (pull or slow monsters, single-target burst, line shot, self buff or speed). All skills share the 100 MP pool (regen 4/s), so new skills add choice, not raw damage. Learn them from a temporary default-Roblox 'skill teacher' NPC in Crossroads: Z at Lv5, X at Lv10, gold price for the user to confirm. A button appears only once its skill is learned, so there are no empty or locked slot teasers.

Beta minimum before the 10/24 freeze: generic UseSkill(slot), a Config.Skills table, LearnSkill, saved LearnedSkillIds, the NPC panel, slot Z, auto using learned slots in order, and a per-victim PvP skill cap. Slot X is a stretch goal for beta. At launch: an equip/swap screen, rare skill books through the LootService drops, skill level-ups that cannot fail, and Firefly icons. Later: job advancement around Lv30, an ultimate on MP plus a long cooldown (never a charge gauge), and pet skills.

Main risk to flag: each skill caps at 35% of a player's MaxHealth on its own, so three skills fired together could one-shot a player in PvP. We need a rolling cap per victim across all skills, and slows/pulls that only work on monsters.

Sources: about a third of the web facts come from search-result summaries, because Fandom, Prima and Gamezebo blocked direct fetches (402/403). This is noted per finding. Nothing was edited in the repo.

findings.topic: World // Zero: skill count, keys and unlocks per class tier
findings.what: Starter (1-star) jobs have a left-click basic attack, E and R actives, and an X ultimate. Jobs of 2 stars and up add F. E/R/F cooldowns are about 5-14 s; X has a 30 s base cooldown; C is a dodge with a 4-5 s cooldown. Higher jobs unlock by level (tier 2 at Lv15), and 5-star jobs need reincarnation. Destructoid adds: 3 starter classes (Defender, Arcane Mage, Swordmaster), 2 actives plus an ultimate each, regular cooldowns about 5-8 s, most classes unlock just by levelling, mastery classes through long quests. A Fandom search snippet (the direct fetch was blocked with 402) says the ultimate charges to 100% passively or by killing mobs, with a 60 s cooldown. The snippet also says tier-1 classes have no ultimate, which contradicts namu.
findings.takeaway_for_us: A basic attack plus 2 actives is the proven starter size for a 3-class kid RPG, and it matches our 3 classes. Do NOT copy the ultimate that charges from kills: it is a charge gauge, which A22 and GDD §0-2 removed. If we add an ultimate later, it should use MP plus a long cooldown.

findings.topic: World // Zero: phone layout and pets (cross-note for the pet request)
findings.what: A search snippet says the mobile layout has movement on the left and the jump button on the right, surrounded by skill buttons and the pet's skill. Namu says pets come from eggs sold in each world's town and give only 'a little help' in combat. Pets have learnable skills, their damage scales with player level, and they can be swapped freely.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Skill buttons belong in an arc around the jump/attack cluster. A pet's active skill would be yet another thumb target. For beta, make pets passive (a small speed or combat %), with no button. GDD.md:438 already plans pets and eggs bought with earned gold only, faction eggs and visible odds (v1.2). Keep pet buffs small, in the spirit of World // Zero's 'little help'.

findings.topic: Blox Fruits: letter keys Z/X/C/V/F, unlocked by mastery
findings.what: Example (Control fruit): Z at base mastery, F at 75, X at 150, C at 250, V at 350. On mobile, the joystick is on the left; attack and the Z/X/C/V/F buttons are on the right. Z/X tend to be fast with short cooldowns, C/V slower and bigger. Keys cannot be remapped.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Roblox kids already read letter keys as skills and expect more of them to open up as they progress. Our free keys: Q (current skill), Z and X. E is taken by interact (A23-10) and R by auto. So use Q/Z/X, smallest and fastest first. Unlocking by mastery means grinding by use; the user chose level + NPC learning instead (skills_progression_2026-10-04.md:10-11).

findings.topic: Swordburst 3: skills tied to the weapon type
findings.what: From search summaries (Prima, PCInvasion and Gamezebo all returned 403 when fetched): 4 equipped skills; each weapon type has its own skill tree with unlock levels. Examples: Sword 'Energy Cleave' at Lv1; Greatsword 'Fissure' at Lv1 and 'Great Rush' at Lv10; Katana skills at Lv10. Universal skills work with any weapon; players get 3 SP per level. Namu adds: 5 weapon types, skills are called 'Burst', the knife has a short 2 s cooldown, the katana long cooldowns, and dual-wield is locked behind an 800 R$ gamepass.
findings.takeaway_for_us: In our game each class has a fixed weapon (Sword/Staff/Bow at Config.luau:257/275/293), so 'class skills' and 'weapon skills' are the same thing. The user's 'cooler weapons' request can share the skill shapes and need not add more skill trees. Never lock a weapon type or a skill behind a paid pass: only change tickets are sold (GDD §10).

findings.topic: Dungeon Quest: rare spells as drops
findings.what: Spells drop from dungeon clears, and the drop table scales with dungeon and difficulty. Rarities run Common to Epic, later Legendary, and change cooldown, range or damage. Spells use cooldowns, not mana. Two ability keys, Q and E. Examples from a search snippet: Fireball 2 s, Whirlwind 9 s, Taunt 8 s, Poison Cloud 10 s.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Matches the user's rule (weapon_progression_user_decisions_2026-10-04.md:13): basic skills from the shop, rare ones from drops, hard quests or bosses. Our new LootService already has item Kinds (Config.luau:1324-1339). A rare skill book could be a new Kind = 'SkillBook' rolled in the same server path: a launch feature, not beta.

findings.topic: Arcane Odyssey: start with one on Q, more through progress, advanced from scrolls
findings.what: Players start with a blast spell in the Q slot. The other 5 base spells unlock by investing stat points (30 per spell). Advanced spells come only from Spell Scrolls. There are 8 technique slots, and some spells can be 'shaped', changing their hitbox and stats.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Same shape as our current state (one MP skill on Q) and our scroll drops. But 8 slots plus stat-point builds are too much for kids on phones: keep 3 slots, and no stat allocation.

findings.topic: MapleStory: job instructor NPC and beginner skills
findings.what: At Lv10, a Beginner advances to a first job through a job instructor NPC in that job's town (Perion warriors, Ellinia magicians, Henesys bowmen, Kerning thieves). Before that, Beginners get 3 small skills, maxed with 9 SP: Nimble Feet (speed +10 for 30 s), Three Snails (a ranged hit) and Recovery. SP is 3 per level. Later job advancements at 30/60/100, and SP must be spent before the next advancement.
findings.takeaway_for_us: A town NPC teacher plus a level gate is a classic model that has worked for kids, and it matches the planned 'skill NPC merchant' (skills_progression:11). Use it for learning; keep SP trees out of beta. A MapleStory-style job advancement (e.g. around Lv30, an NPC test quest) fits our 'job advancement later' (skills_progression:12).

findings.topic: MapleStory M: how auto-battle uses skills
findings.what: Four skill slots; during auto-battle, skills fire in clockwise slot order, so buffs go first. Presets let one button chain skills. Auto-battle unlocks at Lv20 and is limited to 2 h/day, after which you need a ticket or play manually.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Our autoTick (CombatService.luau:1213-1235) only knows BasicSkill. Make it walk the learned slots in a fixed priority. Damage skills fire only when MP and cooldown are ready and an aimed monster is in reach (A23-1, SPEC_ADDENDUM.md:12). Buff skills fire only while monsters are in reach. Never target players. Do not copy the daily limit or paid tickets (reference_lessons_2026-10-05.md:43).

findings.topic: AdventureQuest Worlds: MP plus cooldown, one skill per rank
findings.what: Classes have an auto attack plus 4 actives (5 combat skills) and passives. Skills cost mana and have cooldowns (e.g. 'Reaping Rift' 4 MP / 3 s, 'Final Hours' 45 MP / 3 s). Skills unlock at class ranks 1, 2, 3 and 5; passives at ranks 4 and 10.
findings.takeaway_for_us: A long-running kid MMO uses the same two resources as us (MP plus cooldown), and one new skill per milestone keeps the UI learnable. Supports 'one new button at Lv5, one at Lv10' over handing out a full bar.

findings.topic: Untitled RPG (제목없는 RPG): grind gates to avoid
findings.what: A review says an active goblin-summon skill (100 MP) needed 1,000 goblin kills in an 'enraged' state, a dash upgrade needed 500 uses, and a defence passive came from quests. The reviewer called it 노가다 (grind).
findings.takeaway_for_us: Do not use kill-count or use-count gates for skills; the repo already rejects '1000-kill skill books'. Normal skills: level + NPC + gold. Rare ones: drops, a boss or a hard quest.

findings.topic: Roblox phone button placement
findings.what: Official docs: the default controls take the bottom-left and bottom-right corners; place custom buttons relative to the jump button (the example is 20 px to its left); thumb reach differs between phone and tablet. A search summary of the docs gives a touch zone of at least about 9x9 mm. DevForum tutorial: only in the jump-button zone, never in the thumbstick zone; about 70x70 px on small screens and 120 on large; fire on InputBegan. A DevForum thread suggests an arc or diamond around jump with the main attack bigger.
findings.takeaway_for_us: HUD already anchors attack to the jump button (HUD.luau:3049-3053) and puts the skill button to its left (:3084); touch sizes are 136/102 (HUD.luau:50-51). Slots Z and X need smaller round buttons in an arc above or left of attack. On touch, the 자동/지도/메뉴 square row sits right above attack (HUD.luau:3093-3094), so the layout has to be re-measured at 749x361. Reuse the approved BtnSpecial/IconSpecial parts (HUD.luau:1374-1376) with a text label until Firefly icons exist; do not invent new styling.

findings.topic: Repo: current skill implementation
findings.what: There is exactly one skill. Config.BasicSkill (MP20, cooldown 3, DamageMultiplier 6, Radius 9, PvPCapPct 0.35; Config.luau:333-336) does 6x the full hit while a basic swing does 0.5x, so the skill is 12x a swing (reference_lessons_2026-10-05.md:31). The class only changes the centre: ReleaseCenter Self for Warrior, Target for Mage/Archer (Config.luau:262/280/298), and the Fx (meteor / arrowRain / slash, Fx.luau:3374-3392). CombatService.Release(player, isAuto) handles MP, cooldown, damage, Halo heal, lifesteal and Fx (CombatService.luau:840-1004). The 'Release' remote has no skill ID or slot (:1175-1183, :1299; RateLimit 0.25 at Config.luau:1309). MP: Max 100, regen 4/s, Mage basic swing costs 2 MP (Config.luau:22-25), so the sustained rate is one MP20 skill per 5 s.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Per-class skills means turning Release into a generic UseSkill(slot) that runs Config.Skills definitions: Id, Class, Slot, MinLevel, Price, ManaCost, Cooldown, Shape (SelfAoE / TargetAoE / Line / Cone / Pull / Buff), Mult, Radius, PvPCapPct, AutoUse. Keep 'Release' as the slot-1 alias, but make it go through the same ownership check so it is no back door (skills_progression:60). Use a per-slot ready attribute (SkillReadyAt_1..3) for the HUD.

findings.topic: Repo: learn/slot contract already written, plus conflicting old deferral
findings.takeaway_for_us: The user's new request (2026-10-05) overrides the deferral. Smallest beta version: no equip screen. Each learned skill has a fixed slot (Z or X), and its button appears only after learning, so there is no empty slot and no teaser. Save LearnedSkillIds only and add EquippedSkillSlots at launch with the swap screen. Ask the user one question bundle: levels, prices, and whether slot X makes beta.

findings.topic: Repo: hooks every new skill must keep (quests, auto, factions)
findings.what: Before damage, Release marks m.Rec._skillBy (CombatService.luau:903-904), which the S0 'basic attack only' trial reads (quest_chain_2026-10-06.md:406,515). It fires CombatService.Released with MonstersHit, PlayersHit, Auto and Healed (CombatService.luau:995-1004), which drives the SkillHit quests (quest_chain:102,113,396). Halo ally heal and Horns lifesteal run inside Release (:946-972). A23-1 says auto hits monsters only and auto skills do not count toward skill quests (SPEC_ADDENDUM.md:12-15).
findings.takeaway_for_us: Use one shared post-hit pipeline for all skills (_skillBy mark, Released signal, Halo heal, Horns lifesteal, fxNear), so the existing quests, the crown-shard trial and faction perks keep working without new quest code. That also gives faction flavour per GDD §0 with no new per-faction skill sets: Halo skills heal or shield allies, Horns skills drain.

findings.topic: PvP cap risk with several skills
findings.what: Each Release caps damage to a player at PvPCapPct 0.35 of the target's MaxHealth (Kaiju 0.08) (CombatService.luau:929-933). A basic hit is about 5% (PvP.HitPctOfMaxHP 0.10 x SwingImmediate 0.5; Config.luau:558, 335). The cap is per cast; there is no cap across skills.
findings.takeaway_for_us: With 3 skills on separate cooldowns, Q+Z+X inside about 1 s could do about 105% of MaxHealth and one-shot a player, breaking the cap's intent. Add a rolling cap: all skill damage from one attacker to one victim stays at or below 35% per 3-5 s window (Kaiju 8%). Or give Z/X a lower PvPCapPct (15-20%). Slow, pull and other crowd control must hit monsters only, never players (kid-safe, no griefing).

findings.topic: Movement-speed buffs: skills, pets and anti-cheat
findings.what: WalkSpeed is set in one place, base x class WalkSpeedMult (Archer 1.1) (PlayerService.luau:129). The movement check reads hum.WalkSpeed with MoveMult 1.6 and Slack 8, Enforce=false (ZoneService.luau:149-157; Config.luau:877-887). Server teleports must call ZoneService.MarkTeleported first.
findings.takeaway_for_us: The user wants pets that raise move speed, and an Archer 'wind step' skill would too. Combine them in one server function (class x pet x skill buff) with a total cap (e.g. at most x1.35). It sets Humanoid.WalkSpeed so the anti-cheat stays consistent. For beta, use speed buffs, not CFrame dash or blink skills: those need teleport grace and are harder to make fair in PvP.

findings.topic: Key and button budget
findings.what: Keys in use: F attack, Q skill, E interact, U upgrade, R auto, B menu, M map, 1/2 HP/MP potions. Gamepad: R2 attack, L2 skill (HUD.luau:2884-2899; VitalsUI.luau:214-215; WorldMap.luau:1768). AGENTS.md says HUD.luau is close to Luau's 200-local limit.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Proposed keys: Q / Z / X, gamepad L2 / L1 / R1. Show key badges as on the existing buttons. Keep new HUD state in one table (e.g. ui.skillSlots[i]) and not as new top-level locals. Three skills plus attack plus two potions plus auto is the most a phone screen should carry; that is one more reason pets get no active button in beta.

findings.source: General knowledge of the genre (World // Zero / MapleStory / AQW patterns above) combined with repo Fx.luau:3351-3428, Config.luau:251-306, SPEC_ADDENDUM.md A23-3/A23-6, reference_lessons_2026-10-05.md:32
findings.takeaway_for_us: Balance rule: roughly equal damage per MP across skills, so new skills add choice (gather, burst, line, slow, speed) and not raw damage. Sharing the 100 MP pool (4/s regen) also limits skill spam under auto-combat. The Mage already spends MP on basic swings (2 MP each), so test whether Mage needs more MP regen once it has 3 skills. Names are kid-safe, with no gore. Icons come later through Firefly approval; until then reuse the approved BtnSpecial with a text label.

weapons.summary:
무기 조사 결과 (읽기 전용, 수정 없음).

1) 지금 구조: Config.Weapons의 데이터 8개가 직업 3개 × 진영 이름으로 펼쳐져 이름 있는 무기 약 30종이 된다. 그런데 모양은 기본 블록 몇 개를 색·재질·길이만 바꿔 조립한 것이라 '간지'가 약하다. 베타는 지금 무기를 그대로 쓰고, 최종 3D 무기 27종은 정식 출시 범위다(RELEASE_PLAN:49,64). 젤리 왕관 3종은 이 27종에 들어 있지 않아 실제로는 30종이 필요하다.

2) 큰 구멍:
- T7 진영 무기는 얻는 방법이 아예 없다. 상점은 T3까지만 팔고 드롭 표에도 T7 줄이 없다.
- T4~T6은 0.05~0.5% 드롭뿐이라 기대 처치 수가 200~2000마리다. 거래 금지라 운 나쁜 아이를 구제할 길이 없다.
- 'tier 번호'가 저장 ID·세기 순서·모양 크기를 겸한다. 그래서 무기를 늘리면 깨지는 곳이 있다: 지팡이 구슬 크기, 빛 조건, 상점 연속 판매, '>= 3' 비교, bit32 32개 한도.

3) 외부 조사에서 공통으로 보인 '멋'의 요소:
- 등급 색 + 별: WoW·Hypixel은 일반 흰 → 고급 초록 → 희귀 파랑 → 영웅 보라 → 전설 주황/금. 메이플은 레전드리가 초록이라 다르다.
- 강화 단계별 빛: 리니지2는 +4 파랑 → +7 진파랑 → +10 진홍.
- 지역마다 직업 레인별 테마 무기 1개: Dungeon Quest.
- 최상위는 보스 재료 제작: Swordburst2 Burst, 몬스터헌터 무기 트리.
- 전설은 아주 소수만: Blox Fruits는 약 41종 중 신화가 5종.
- 외형과 능력치 분리: Wizard101 스티칭.

4) 단계별 제안:
- 베타 MVP (10/24 마감 전, 그림 없이 데이터·글자만):
  - 무기에 Grade/Source 필드를 추가하고 목록은 뒤에만 붙인다.
  - 등급 색·별 표시.
  - 영웅 이상 드롭과 +10 성공을 서버 전체에 알림.
  - 무기 드롭 천장(실패 누적 보장).
  - 강화 +4/+7/+10 빛은 기존 빛·반짝이 효과를 재사용하되 사용자 승인 후.
  - T4~T6 이름을 지역 테마로 바꾸는 것도 사용자 승인 후.
- 정식 출시:
  - Firefly 시안 → 3D 무기 30종.

pets.summary:
Pet system research for Halo & Horns (scope: the pet part of the 2026-10-05 request; class skills and weapons were not covered here). I did not edit anything.

Repo facts:
- There is no pet or companion code in src/. The only grep hits for "pet/펫/companion/동료" are the Halo ally-heal and reference-table mentions.
- The GDD already holds a pet plan in roadmap row v1.2 (GDD.md:438): pets and eggs bought with earned gold only, odds shown, a Halo-only "새벽 알", a Horns-only "저주받은 알", and a codex with grey silhouettes.
- GDD.md:457 places pets after MVP. RELEASE_PLAN's beta list (RELEASE_PLAN.md:47-61) has no pets, and the 2026-10-05 reference review marked pets "skip".
- So a pet in the beta needs the user's explicit OK, and it would compete with an already crowded 19-day window before the 10/24 feature freeze.

Hook points to reuse:
- Move speed: PlayerService.applyStats sets WalkSpeed (PlayerService.luau:129). The anti-cheat already scales with hum.WalkSpeed (ZoneService.luau:157), so a pet multiplier added there stays consistent.
- PvE-only damage: put the pet bonus in ComputeMonsterHit (CombatService.luau:388-395), not GetDamageBonus. GetDamageBonus feeds ComputePvPHit (CombatService.luau:360-372, 403-424), so this keeps the 5%/35% PvP caps intact.
- Egg drops: add a new row type to the LootService.RollKill tables (LootService.luau:163-209, Config.luau:1343-1388).
- Rarity borders: ART_DIRECTION.md:56 already defines them "for items/pets".
- Pet names: reuse the A21 nickname filter path (SPEC_ADDENDUM.md:1001).
- Starter pet with no new art: the existing Slime and GoldenGoose 3D models. They live in ServerStorage, so a ReplicatedStorage copy is needed for client rendering.

Web findings:
- How other games give pets: eggs bought with earned currency (Pet Sim 99, Arm Wrestle, Grow a Garden), eggs that hatch by doing tasks (Adopt Me: 4-6 tasks), and quest or boss drops (Dungeon Heroes).
- Equip limits: 3 slots growing to 8 (Grow a Garden), 3 to 5 (Anime Fighters), up to 99 (Pet Sim 99). Extra slots are often sold as gamepasses.
- Move-speed pets cluster around +10-15%: Grey Mouse +10%, Raptor ~+14%, Hasty Bee +15%. Bee Swarm hive bonuses of the same type do not stack. Pet Sim 99's walk-speed enchant is rated weak because teleports make walking speed irrelevant.
- Growth: Adopt Me ages pets newborn to full-grown, and four full-grown make one neon. Pet Sim 99 fuses 3-100 pets and has 1-in-500k+ "huge" odds.
- Performance: render pets on the client and keep only data on the server. DevForum numbers are 100 pets at 160-200 FPS on PC and 200 pets at about 100-140 FPS, with phones much worse.
- Roblox paid-random-item rules (official doc plus a 2026-05-26 DevForum clarification):
  - Covered items include Robux eggs, currency bought with Robux, luck boosts, pity systems, enhancement items with random success, and bundles.
  - Odds must be shown numerically before purchase and sum to 100%; every outcome must give some benefit.
  - ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted and IsPaidItemTradingAllowed are mandatory, with a compliant alternative (AU/BE/NL/UK/BR).
  - Free random rewards need no odds disclosure.
- Kid-safety concerns: Pet Sim 99 is criticised as a slot machine with FOMO and trading scams; Adopt Me has trade scams and real-money resale; a 2026-05-20 FTC complaint targets Roblox's manipulative monetization; and Vesteria players criticised stat pets locked behind Robux as pay-to-win.

Recommendation:
- Make pets earnable only. No trading, no Robux, no hunger, and no consuming or destroying pets: duplicates merge into stars automatically.
- One equipped pet with one passive buff:
  - move speed +5-12% by rarity, with a total speed cap;
  - or PvE-only damage, gold, XP or MP-regen +3-10%.
  - Same-type buffs never stack, and the slime-jackpot roll is excluded from luck buffs.
- Pets level up by kills while equipped (auto-combat kills count).
- Tie pets to GDD §0:
  - getting the first pet is a 정화/길들이기 choice (Halo honor or Horns infamy +1);
  - faction eggs at launch;
  - an angel-form or devil-form evolution later;
  - the Neutral guild crafts a clockwork pet from monster materials when crafting arrives.

Scope:
- Beta (only if the user approves a stretch): a "아기 슬라임" starter pet from a Lv5 side quest, built on the existing slime model, 1 slot, speed buff only.
- Launch (12/19): egg drops, gold eggs, faction eggs, 2 slots, pet levels, codex, and new pet art (Firefly/Tripo, user-approved).
- Later: evolution, and paid eggs only under the GDD §10-1 rules.

findings.takeaway_for_us: Beta stretch: '아기 슬라임' can be the existing slime model at about 0.35 scale (golden variant = the existing Highlight). That respects 'no new visual style in code'. The user still sees and approves it. Copy one template into ReplicatedStorage for client rendering. Real pet designs come later via Firefly concepts, then Tripo (paid, quote the total first).

findings.topic: Repo: no trading, kept progress, faction rules
findings.what: A23-12 keeps 'no item trading (1:1 trading ban)'. Kids' promise: only change tickets are sold now, and losses are always small. Rebirth resets level, gold and weapons but keeps marks and tickets. The legendary weapon is KeepOnRebirth. Neutral (장인 길드) crafting is phase 2.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Pets are account-bound: no trade, no gift. They are kept through rebirth and faction switches, so nothing is lost. A faction egg stays usable after a switch; only buying needs that faction's town. Neutral gets its pet via crafting from monster materials when phase-2 crafting lands (launch or later).

findings.topic: Pet Simulator 99: scale, rarity and fusing
findings.what: Pet Sim 99 lets players equip up to 99 pets. Slots unlock by rank and are bought with diamonds (ranks 1-5 unlock slots 1-5, ranks 11-15 unlock slots 6-8). Huge pets are estimated at 1/500k to 1/1M, with golden and rainbow far rarer. The Fuse Machine combines 3-100 pets into one, and rainbow needs 10 identical golden pets for about +27%.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Do not copy massive rosters, astronomical odds or 'fuse many into one'. Consuming pets reads like loss to kids. Use a small roster (about 6-10 species at launch), 1 slot (beta) or 2 (launch). Duplicates auto-merge into +1 star on the owned pet (max 5), so no pet is ever consumed by choice or failure.

findings.topic: Pet Simulator 99: monetization not to copy
findings.what: Gamepasses sell egg luck (Lucky +200% for 275 R$, Ultra Lucky +500% for 800 R$), Auto Farm and Auto Tap. Critics call egg hatching a slot machine built on FOMO and scarcity, and say its trading plaza is full of scams.
findings.takeaway_for_us: This matches what the GDD already refuses (selling auto-hunt). Sell no luck passes, no hatch-speed passes and no slot passes. Get extra slots by quest or level. Avoid time-limited FOMO eggs; seasonal eggs should come back each year.

findings.topic: Move-speed pets in other games: typical values and stacking
findings.what: Grow a Garden: Grey Mouse gives +10% player move speed and Raptor about +14-14.5%. Slots start at 3 and reach 8 via aged-pet trade-ins or Robux. Pets have hunger. Bee Swarm: Hasty Bee's gifted hive bonus is +15% player movespeed, the only one of its kind, and gifted hive bonuses of the same type do not stack.
findings.takeaway_for_us: A pet speed buff of +5% (common) up to +12% (legendary) fits genre norms; +10% is 'feels faster' without breaking chases. Same-type bonuses don't stack (Bee Swarm rule), so 2 slots can't double speed. Skip hunger and feeding: it is a chore (GDD §3 rejects forced homework) and pet neglect guilt is not kid-friendly.

findings.topic: Speed only matters if the world rewards it
findings.what: A Pet Sim 99 enchant ranking calls the Speed enchant nearly useless because hoverboards and teleport cannons are faster, and ranks Strong Pets and Coins far higher.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Our menu travel and pads remove long walks, so speed matters inside zones: kiting monsters as a Mage or Archer, grudge-sack chases and escapes, goose rushes. Offer speed as one of several pet stat types (speed / PvE damage / gold / XP / MP regen) so players choose. Speed is the user's headline ask, so make the first pet a speed pet.

findings.topic: Adopt Me: grow by playing, merge duplicates
findings.what: Pets age newborn → junior → pre-teen → teen → post-teen → full grown by doing tasks. Four full-grown pets of one type make a Neon, and four max-age Neons make a Mega Neon. Eggs hatch after tasks (cracked egg 4, others 6) rather than real-time waits.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Hatching and leveling should come from play, not timers. An egg hatches after N monster kills while it sits in the 'incubator' (one at a time; auto kills count, matching the jackpot rule). The pet levels 1-10 from kills while equipped. Lv1 gives about 60% of its max buff and Lv10 gives 100%, with only small steps, so new players are not far behind.

findings.topic: Adopt Me: trading harms
findings.what: Adopt Me added a Trade License (a 3-question safety quiz), a 30-day trade history, in-game scam reports and unfair-trade warnings, and it does not restore scammed pets. Parent guides say rare pets resell off-platform for about $100+ and list 'trust trade' and off-platform scams that bring grooming risk.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Our existing ban on 1:1 trading removes the biggest pet-game harm: scams, off-platform sale and stranger pressure. Keep pets account-bound, no gifting. Show-off happens through visible pets and the codex instead.

findings.topic: Roblox ToS: real-money trading
findings.what: The Community Standards ban off-platform, secondary-market sale of virtual items and accounts, and ban developers selling on-platform items through off-platform payment.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Rare pets would invite real-money trading and account theft if they were tradeable. Untradeable pets make them worthless to resellers, so this is another reason to keep the no-trade rule.

findings.topic: Anime Fighters Simulator: attacking pets add complexity
findings.what: Equipped fighters follow the player and attack whatever enemy the player clicks. Players start with 3 slots; 5 come from a gamepass or free time trials. There are 10 rarity tiers up to Heavenly or Demonic.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Attacking pets would need targeting, hitboxes, PvP rules and server load. For beta and launch, pets give passive buffs only and play a 'cheer' Fx on kill or skill with existing particles. If pet attacks come later, they hit monsters only, never players, kaiju or the goose, matching the A23-1 auto rules.

findings.topic: RPG pets on Roblox: Dungeon Heroes and Vesteria
findings.what: Dungeon Heroes gives pets from daily quests (formerly chests and boss drops). Pets attack only what the player swings at, and merging same pets raises rarity. In Vesteria, of 114 pets only 11 gave stats, some locked behind Robux bundles or events. Players criticised this as pay-to-win and complained it pushed them away from cute cosmetic pets; ideas included separate vanity slots.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Every buff pet must be earnable for free (quest, drop, gold egg, crafting); none locked behind Robux or a limited event. Keep buffs small so a favourite cute pet is never a big handicap. Later option: a 'look' override that shows any owned pet while keeping the buff of the equipped one.

findings.topic: Roblox paid random items: official rules
findings.what: Covered: Robux, currency bought with Robux, enhancement items with random success, and luck boosts, pity systems and rate-up items. Odds for every outcome must show as percentages summing to 100% before purchase (an icon alone is not enough), and must update dynamically. If ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted is true, offer a free earnable path, a guaranteed direct purchase or a disclosed fixed sequence, or hide or block the feature. Free random rewards need no disclosure. IsPaidItemTradingAllowed gates trading of paid outcomes.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Now: eggs cost earned gold only, so they are not paid random items. Still show the odds in the egg panel (GDD v1.2 promise, a good kid-facing practice). Later (§10-1): any Robux egg, luck boost or pity needs the full disclosure plus the PolicyService check. Our 10/30/70% scrolls would also become paid random items if ever sold for Robux.

findings.topic: Roblox paid random items: 2026 clarification
findings.what: A DevForum announcement dated 2026-05-26 clarifies the scope: capsule, enhancement, combination and probability-adjustment items. Bundles that contain random items are fully covered. Every outcome must give some benefit (no 'loss' results). Creators must use ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted and IsPaidItemTradingAllowed for regulated markets (Australia, Belgium, Netherlands, UK, Brazil). Non-compliance leads to moderation, and creators should check with the Studio Player Emulator.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Record this in GDD §10-1 as the checklist for any future paid egg. Design eggs so the worst result is still a useful pet; no 'nothing' result. Our duplicate → +1 star rule satisfies 'every outcome gives a benefit'.

findings.topic: Pet follow performance
findings.what: DevForum advice: the server stores and replicates ownership and equip state; clients create and move every pet (their own and others') using AlignPosition or CFrame lerp, not repeated tweens. Reported numbers: 1 player with 100 pets runs at 160-200 FPS; 2 players with 200 pets total at about 100-140 FPS on PC. Mobile degrades much more, and 1,000 pets across 10 players stays a problem.
findings.takeaway_for_us: With 20 players we can afford 1 pet each (beta) or 2 (launch), i.e. 20-40 small models. The GDD already budgets for phones (monster cap, 25 damage numbers). Server: an `EquippedPet` attribute only. Client: a PetFollow module that renders pets within about 100 studs, makes them non-collidable and untargetable, snaps them after teleports and hides them during the intro or opening.

findings.topic: Kid-safety and regulatory climate
findings.what: Fairplay and NCOSE filed an FTC complaint about Roblox's manipulative monetization and addictive design (Fortune, 2026-05-20). A University of Sydney report on misleading Roblox monetization, and CHI 2025 papers on how children experience harm from game monetization, flag chance-based mechanics, layered currencies and loss-moment purchase prompts.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Supports GDD §2/§10-1: no paid eggs now, no purchase pop-ups after deaths or losses, no countdown 'last chance' eggs. Pets are kid-safe in look: Halo = a dawn chick or lamb with a tiny halo; Horns = a mischievous imp or bat with small horns, no blood, skulls or scary gore; Neutral = a teal clockwork critter. All designs go through the Firefly approval and moderation-check workflow.

findings.topic: Design synthesis: buffs, slots and caps (proposal, user to confirm numbers)
findings.what: Proposal built from the findings above, not an existing decision.
findings.source: Synthesis of the findings above; hooks at PlayerService.luau:129 and CombatService.luau:388-395
findings.takeaway_for_us:
Each species has one stat type:
- MoveSpeed: +5 / 7 / 9 / 11 / 12% by rarity (common → legendary).
- PvE damage: +3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 10%.
- Gold or XP: +5-10%.
- MP regen: +10-25%.

Rules:
- Values are at pet Lv10; Lv1 gives 60% of that.
- Same stat type never stacks.
- Total speed multiplier capped at 1.25 including Archer.
- Damage is PvE only.
- The luck buff excludes the Jackpot.
- Buffs work during auto-combat too.
- Slots: 1 in beta; a 2nd at launch from a Lv15 quest or chapter 3. Never sold.
- Server data: `Pets = {[species] = {Stars, Level, XP, Name}}`, `EquippedPet`, and an incubator egg.
- Remotes EquipPet, HatchEgg/BuyEgg (gold) and RenamePet get RateLimits entries and server distance and readiness checks (A23-4 pattern).

findings.topic: Design synthesis: tie pets to the GDD §0 angel/devil core
findings.what: Proposal: make getting and growing a pet an angel-or-devil choice so pets reinforce the core rule instead of being a generic simulator add-on.
findings.source: docs/GDD.md:7-12,438; docs/design/quest_chain_2026-10-06.md:159,111 (S0 and M2-3 two-button choice pattern); docs/SPEC_ADDENDUM.md:25
findings.takeaway_for_us: First pet = a side quest '길 잃은 아기 슬라임' (Lv5, after chapter 1). [보살펴요] gives Halo honor +1; [길들여요] gives Horns infamy +1; Neutral records the choice only. Both choices give the same pet, so neither is a punishment. At launch, faction eggs (새벽 알 / 저주받은 알) are sold for gold in their faction towns. Later, a Lv10 pet evolves into a light-wing or small-horn form that follows the owner's Honor/Infamy lean, so 'how you played shows on you'.

findings.topic: Scope split: MVP-for-beta vs launch vs later
findings.what: Proposal respecting the 10/24 freeze, GDD.md:457 ('pets after MVP') and the art workflow (Firefly first, Tripo is paid).
findings.takeaway_for_us:
Beta (stretch, only with user approval, about 2-3 dev days):
- PetService: data, equip, server speed buff.
- PetFollow client module.
- The 아기 슬라임 side quest as a story-engine data row.
- The pet shown in the existing item list.
- Existing slime model; 1 slot; speed buff only; no eggs, names or codex.

Launch (12/19):
- Egg drop rows plus a gold egg nest with on-screen odds.
- Faction eggs, incubator hatching by kills, 5 rarities.
- Levels and stars, 2nd slot, silhouette codex, filtered naming.
- 6-10 species with Firefly concepts, then Tripo models (quote the total first).

Later:
- Evolution forms, the Neutral crafted pet (phase-2 crafting), optional look override.
- Any paid egg only under §10-1 (odds summing to 100%, PolicyService checks, no loss outcomes, free path kept).

fit.summary:
Read-only research on the user's 2026-10-05 request for class skills, more and cooler weapons, and cute pets that give combat or speed boosts. I made no edits.

What the game already has:
- **Skills:** each class has one skill (`Release`: Warrior shockwave, Mage meteor, Archer arrow rain). The faction flavour is already in the combat code: Halo heals allies, Horns lifesteal (+15% damage), Neutral gets no combat buffs.
- **Weapons:** there are 8 tiers. Each weapon is identified only by (class, tier), and ownership is stored as a bit32 bitmask. The tier-7 faction weapons (여명/파멸/왕관 조각) have names and 9 icons but no way to obtain them: the shop sells up to T3 and the drop tables only have T4–T6.
- **Pets:** there is no pet code. GDD v1.2 already plans pets and eggs bought with earned gold, with odds shown, faction-only eggs and a codex.

Constraints that matter:
1. **Swing damage has no hard PvP cap.** It is about 5% of the target's base HP, but bonuses can push it to roughly 22%. Any pet, skill or weapon bonus added to the shared `GetDamageBonus`/`GetDamageMult` raises PvP damage with nothing to stop it. PvE bonuses must go only into `ComputeMonsterHit`.
2. **Multiple skills break the PvP cap.** Each skill is capped separately at 35% of the target's current MaxHealth (8% on the kaiju). With 2–3 skills on separate cooldowns, a combo can deal 70–105%. We need a shared PvP skill budget per attacker and victim, and crowd control (slow/stun) should hit monsters only.
3. **Auto combat only knows one skill.** Auto mode hits monsters only, the goose and kaiju need manual hits, and skill quests count only manual skills. New skills must keep the `isAuto` flag and set `_skillBy`.
4. **The bully rule and Size Justice measure power by level and weapon tier only.** If pets stay PvE-only, neither needs to change.
5. **Speed boosts can trigger the anti-cheat.** WalkSpeed is set only in `PlayerService.applyStats` (20 × 1.1 for Archer). The movement check reads the server-side WalkSpeed, so a server-applied pet boost is safe. A boost set on the client does not replicate and would show up as false "suspicious move" logs, and as pull-backs if `Enforce` is ever turned on. Dash skills must call `MarkTeleported`.
6. **Size Justice may already be changing WalkSpeed.** Forum threads (not Roblox docs) say `Model:ScaleTo` scales WalkSpeed. Size Justice calls ScaleTo every tick while `applyStats` resets the speed, so it may drift. This is unverified and needs a Studio check.
7. **Speed matters in PvP even without damage:** the 45 s grudge-sack escape, the 120 s kaiju and bounty chases. Pet speed should be off in PvP zones, while combat-tagged, while carrying a sack, at 3+ wanted stars and as the kaiju.
8. **MP:** max 100, regen 4/s, the current skill costs 20 MP with a 3 s cooldown, and a skill hits for 12× a basic attack.
9. **Free keys:** Q is the skill key; F, R, U, B, E, M, 1 and 2 are taken, so Z and X are free (Blox Fruits uses Z/X/C/V). HUD.luau and Fx.luau are close to the 200-local limit.

Ideas that fit the core rule (every action tilts angel or devil):
- **Pets:** pets hatch neutral and turn angel (mini halo) or devil (mini horns) based on the owner's actions while equipped (Chao-style), reusing the existing halo and horns builders. Neutral pets get the artisan gear look.
- **Skills:** each class skill has one base and a faction twist (inFAMOUS-style). Halo heals or shields allies, Horns drains with the existing lifesteal caps, Neutral gets utility only (gathering monsters, materials) because GDD §5-8 forbids Neutral combat buffs.
- **Weapons:** T7 becomes the faction weapon earned by Honor/Infamy rank plus elite or boss materials. Neutral guild crafting comes at launch.

Pets and eggs earned only with gold need no odds disclosure. If Robux ever buys gold, the gold eggs become paid random items: they then need odds UI, a PolicyService check, and any luck boost disclosed in numbers.

Suggested phasing (all needs the user's approval):
- **Beta MVP (freeze 10/24, 19 days left):** at most a second skill per class with a fixed slot, and maybe one optional story pet (a baby slime built from the approved Slime model, +5% speed outside PvP).
- **Launch:** a third skill, rank-gated twists and a slot screen; the T7 faction forge; the 27 final 3D weapons; a pet slot with 3–6 pets, bond levels and the angel/devil evolution, PvE-only bonuses.
- **Later:** cosmetic weapon skins, boss-material sets, gold eggs (v1.2), Neutral-crafted pets, and paid eggs only under GDD §10-1.

These scope decisions conflict with earlier notes that pushed skill learning/slots/class advancement and pets until after the MVP. The new user request overrides those notes, but the user still has to choose the scope.

findings.topic: Current skills: 1 per class, no slot system
findings.what: Each class has exactly one MP skill via the `Release` remote, which takes no skill id. Config.BasicSkill: ManaCost 20, Cooldown 3, DamageMultiplier 6, Radius 9, PvPCapPct 0.35. The class sets the shape through ReleaseCenter: Warrior Self shockwave, Mage/Archer Target meteor/arrow rain. Fx draws one faction-coloured effect per class. LearnedSkillIds, EquippedSkillSlots, LearnSkill/UseSkill and SkillService do not exist.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Class skills should become a data table (Config.Skills[SkillId] = {Class, MinLevel, Mana, Cooldown, Shape, DamageMult, PvPCapPct, FactionTwist}) behind one server path, UseSkill(slot). Slot 1 maps to the current Release so saves, quests and the S0 trial keep working. Follow the contract already proposed in skills_progression §3: fixed SkillId, learned set, slot table, server validation.

findings.topic: Faction flavour already in combat (base for skill twists)
findings.what: Halo: allies inside the skill radius are healed by 10% of the real damage dealt, capped at 30% of MaxHP (a whiff heals nothing). Halo also gets a party aura of +5% per Halo ally (max 3, 30 studs), regen 2%/s and MaxHP x1.2. Horns: damage +15% and lifesteal of 10% of damage, capped at 3% MaxHP per hit (kaiju cap uses base HP). Neutral: no combat, economy or regen buffs and no heal (GDD §5-8).
findings.takeaway_for_us: Faction skill variants should amplify these existing identities and reuse their code paths. Halo twist = heal or shield allies (HealPlayer plus the HaloHealCapPct caps; Released.Healed already gives kaiju-raid credit). Horns twist = drain or aggression via applyLifesteal caps. Neutral twist = utility only, such as gathering monsters or an extra material roll, because GDD §5-8 forbids Neutral combat buffs.

findings.topic: Weapons: 8 tiers; T7 faction weapons cannot be obtained
findings.what: Tiers T1-T3 are sold (MaxSoldTier 3). T4-T6 come only from tiny drop chances (Goblin/Brute T4, Skeleton T5, Knight T5/T6). T7 (여명/파멸/왕관 조각 검·지팡이·활, RequiresFaction, 9 icons) is neither sold nor in any Loot.Tables row, so it cannot be obtained. T8 '젤리 왕관' (Damage 90, about 2.4x T3) drops from slimes at 1/20000 and is kept through rebirth. In-hand looks are procedural parts (Color/Material/Length): tier>=6 adds a PointLight, tier>=7 sparkles.
findings.takeaway_for_us: T7 is the natural home for 'cool faction weapons' that express GDD §0. Give it a path: a faction forge that needs Honor/Infamy rank (for example rank 3 성기사/군벌, Config.Titles thresholds 0/10/50/200/1000) plus elite or boss materials (KnightCrest/BruteHorn already drop). This follows GDD §0-1 'top tier = boss materials'. Neutral 왕관 조각 weapons fit guild crafting (phase 2).

findings.topic: Weapon identity model limits 'many more weapons'
findings.what: A weapon is identified only by (class, tier). Ownership is a bit32 bitmask with valid bits up to MaxWeaponTier (32 bits at most). Enhancement is stored per tier. Weapon Damage feeds PowerOf (Size Justice and the bully rule) and the PvP power ratio, which is clamped to 0.8-1.5.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Do not add dozens of new tiers. 'Many cooler weapons' should be cosmetic variants (a WeaponSkin per tier with identical stats), or a separate WeaponId table if special effects are ever wanted. Any special effect (speed, crit, drain) must be PvE-only, or it leaks into PvP, Justice and bully balance.

findings.topic: PvP caps: basic hit has no hard clamp
findings.what: PvP swing = victim base MaxHP x 0.10 x 0.5 (about 5%) x weapon ratio clamp(0.8, 1.5) x class Damage x (1 + GetDamageBonus) x GetDamageMult (Justice S x bully) x ranged PvPMult 0.85. GetDamageBonus includes Horns +15%, stars +5% each, Halo aura up to +15% and revenge +25%. There is no final clamp: the worst case is about 5% x 1.5 x 1.105 x 1.65 x 1.6, roughly 22% of base HP per swing. Skills are clamped to 35% of the victim's current MaxHealth (which includes Justice S), and an Active kaiju to 8%.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Never add pet, skill or weapon bonuses to GetDamageBonus or GetDamageMult, because ComputePvPHit uses them too (:422-423). Put PvE-only multipliers in ComputeMonsterHit (:388-401). Consider adding a hard swing cap (for example 8% of base HP) before more bonus sources exist.

findings.topic: Multiple skills break the 35% one-shot promise
findings.what: The PvP cap applies per Release. With 2-3 skills on separate cooldowns, a burst of 3 x 35% = 105% kills in about 1 second, which contradicts GDD §5-2 ('no one-shot'). Each skill also deals 8% to the kaiju, so the raid gets shorter. Crit never applies to skills or PvP.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Add a per-attacker-to-victim rolling PvP skill budget (for example at most 35% of MaxHealth per 4 s across all skills) and a matching kaiju budget (at most 8% per window), or a shared global cooldown. Keep slows, stuns and knockback monster-only, like the auto rules, to avoid kid-griefing.

findings.topic: Auto-combat, goose and kaiju rules new skills and pets must keep
findings.what: autoReady needs Unlocked + Enabled + ClassChosen + not kaiju + alive. In auto mode the code never collects player targets (:684, :699, :715, :745, :878, :923). autoTick knows only BasicSkill and casts it only if a monster is in reach (:1213-1235). Auto hits are not 'activity'. Goose rewards need 3 or more manual counts (manual 2, auto 1, max 3 per second). Kaiju healer credit ignores Auto releases. Skill quests count manual skills that hit at least 1 monster. The S0 trial ① reads m.Rec._skillBy.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Every new skill must accept isAuto, skip players when auto, mark _skillBy, and fire Released with Auto and MonstersHit. autoTick needs a skill priority list. Any pet that attacks must follow auto semantics: monsters only, no goose, kaiju or skill-quest credit. Pet regen or auto-potion combined with auto combat would allow endless AFK jackpot farming (the reference notes warn against auto-potion), so keep pet sustain small.

findings.topic: Rookie protection and CanAttack order
findings.what: IsRookie = Rebirths == 0 and (Level < 15 or PlaytimeSeconds < 3600). CanAttack checks in order: Neutral either side, then fighter factions and same faction, then the Halo-hits-Active-kaiju exception (any zone, rookies allowed), then PvP zone or tag, then rookie, then Protected (10 s spawn shield that breaks when you hit a player).
findings.takeaway_for_us: Any new skill shape (line, cone, dash, DoT) must pick player targets only through playersNear(), which calls CanAttack, and must call BreakProtection after hitting players. DoT or mark effects must re-check CanAttack on every tick, not only when cast.

findings.topic: Size Justice and bully rule see only level and weapon tier
findings.what: Bully 'weak victim' uses GetCombatPower = PowerOf(level, tier, 1) = sqrt(WeaponDamage x BaseHealth). Scroll enhancement is ignored, while T8's Damage 90 is counted. S = clamp(sqrt(enemy / ours), 1.0, 1.6) multiplies size, HP and damage. Each bully stack is -15% size and damage, max 3. Neutral S is always 1 and excluded from sums.
findings.takeaway_for_us: If pets and skills give no PvP stats, Justice and bully need no change. If any pet or skill ever adds PvP power, PowerOf must include it or the bully rule will underestimate strong attackers.

findings.topic: Move speed path and anti-cheat (CR-H2)
findings.what: WalkSpeed = Config.Player.WalkSpeed 20 x class WalkSpeedMult (Archer 1.1), set only in PlayerService.applyStats. That runs on spawn and RefreshCharacter (Justice S change, kaiju, level and class). ZoneService.checkMove runs every 0.2 s and allows flat movement up to hum.WalkSpeed x 1.6 x dt + 8 studs. Enforce = false, so it only logs; with Enforce = true it pulls the player back. Server teleports call MarkTeleported first.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Apply pet speed server-side inside applyStats (one formula: base x class x pet) so the check reads the true speed. A client-set WalkSpeed does not replicate, so the server would log false 'suspicious move' warnings, and pull players back if Enforce is ever turned on. Any dash or blink skill must call ZoneService.MarkTeleported and respect zone MinLevel. Keep pet speed at +10% or less: 20 x 1.1 x 1.1 is about 24.2 studs/s, well inside the slack.

findings.topic: Model:ScaleTo scales Humanoid WalkSpeed (Justice may already change speed)
findings.what: Forum threads report that Model:ScaleTo also scales Humanoid WalkSpeed and JumpHeight, with no way to exclude them, so developers reset them manually. The official ScaleTo reference page says nothing either way. JusticeService calls ScaleTo every tick toward S (1.0-1.6), the bully shrink and the kaiju x3, while applyStats resets WalkSpeed only on RefreshCharacter. Speed may therefore drift with size in the current build. Not verified in Studio.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Before adding pet speed, add a single computeWalkSpeed(player) and reapply it after every applyScale. Then measure WalkSpeed in Studio at S 1.0, 1.6 and kaiju 3x to decide whether giants should be faster. This could be a hidden balance bug on its own (unverified).

findings.topic: Speed changes PvP outcomes even without damage
findings.what: The grudge sack runs a 45 s escape timer only inside PvP zones, sack carriers cannot teleport, players with 3 or more stars cannot Travel, and the kaiju has 120 s to survive. Chases and escapes depend on WalkSpeed.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Pet speed bonus should be inactive in PvP zones (Zones[].PvP) and while InCombatUntil > now, SackGold > 0, WantedStars >= 3 or KaijuState is Active, or else identical for everyone. Recommend the zone or flag gate. Attribute names already exist: InCombatUntil, SackGold, WantedStars, KaijuState.

findings.topic: MP economy numbers
findings.what: MaxMana 100, ManaRegen 4/s (session only), the skill costs 20 MP with a 3 s cooldown, Mage basic attack costs 2 MP per 1.1 s, MP potion restores 40% with a 10 s cooldown and costs 25 gold. A skill hits for 12x a basic attack (DamageMultiplier 6 vs SwingImmediate 0.5); Lv1 skill damage is about Warrior 48, Mage 62, Archer 26. TrySpendMana does not start the cooldown when the MP check fails.
findings.takeaway_for_us: With 2-3 skills, MP becomes the shared limit: 4/s pays for one 20-MP skill every 5 s. Proposed (needs user OK): new skills cost 25-40 MP with 6-12 s cooldowns so basic attacks stay meaningful. Pet 'MP regen +10-20%' is a mild PvE-leaning bonus, but it also raises PvP skill frequency, so keep it small.

findings.topic: Input keys and HUD constraints
findings.what: Taken: F attack, Q skill, R auto toggle, U upgrade, B menu, E interact prompts, M map, 1 and 2 potions, gamepad R2/L2. The skill button reuses roundButton('Release', ..., 'BtnSpecial'). HUD.luau and Fx.luau are near the Luau 200-local limit. A full HUD relayout with Firefly art is planned (step 6). The phone target is 749x361. GDD §6 promises the same buttons for every class.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Keep Q for skill 1 and use Z, then X, for skills 2 and 3, the same keys for all classes. Add phone buttons with the existing BtnSpecial part and put new state in tables (L/TXT/COL). Each extra button crowds the 749x361 layout, so plan slot buttons into the HUD redesign mockup.

findings.topic: Skill key convention in popular Roblox games
findings.what: Blox Fruits uses Z/X/C/V for moves and F for sword or travel moves on PC, with matching on-screen buttons on mobile and no remapping.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Z/X for extra skills are familiar to our audience. Our F is already attack and Q is skill, so the scheme becomes Q (skill 1), Z (skill 2), X (skill 3).

findings.topic: Data, remote and loot conventions to reuse
findings.what: Remotes are declared in Net.Names. Rate limits live in Config.RateLimits (Release 0.25, UseItem 0.4, EquipWeapon 0.3). Save data adds fields to Data.Defaults (Items, WeaponEnhance, Story.Pick). LootService is the only writer of Items, granted per contributor roll with no ground pickup. Story.Pick.S0 stores 'Purify' or 'Devour'.

Add data.Pets = {Owned = {[id] = {Bond, Tilt}}, Equipped}, mirroring only the equipped id and form. Skills can use keyed LearnedSkills and SkillSlots tables. Story.Pick.S0 can seed the first pet's or skill's tilt.

findings.topic: Kid-safe wording
findings.what: The review lists '흡혈' wording and a bloody-sword icon as items to re-check for child safety. The current Horns perk text already says '체력 흡수'. Hard rule 1 requires modest, non-gory character art (the old account was suspended).

findings.topic: Pets in our own plan already
findings.what: GDD roadmap v1.2: pets and eggs bought only with earned gold, odds shown, Halo-only '새벽 알' and Horns-only '저주받은 알', and a codex with grey silhouettes. The GDD risk table says pets and bosses come after the MVP. ART_DIRECTION already defines rarity border colours for items and pets.
findings.takeaway_for_us: The user's pet request extends an existing plan rather than inventing a new one. The new parts are 'cute + combat or move-speed bonus' and the timing, which conflicts with 'after MVP' and needs a scope decision.

findings.topic: Pet alignment that grows angel or devil (Chao model)
findings.what: In Sonic Adventure 2, Chao hatch neutral and drift toward Hero (white, halo-shaped emotion ball) or Dark (dark, spiky) depending on which side's characters raise them. Raised by both equally, they stay Neutral.
findings.takeaway_for_us: A direct fit for GDD §0 ('겉모습으로 보인다'). Pets hatch as a neutral baby. While equipped they gain 빛 or 어둠 tilt from the owner's actions: Honor or Infamy gained, the S0 Purify/Devour choice, Halo skill heals, Horns plunder. At thresholds they evolve into a mini-halo or mini-horns form. Reuse the approved halo disc and horns builders (CharacterVisuals.luau:367-412) and the Neutral gear mark (:342) for an artisan form. Tilt points should go to the pet, not to titles, so it cannot be farmed into rank.

findings.topic: Pet bond and abilities in RPGs (Ragnarok Online, World//Zero)
findings.what: In Ragnarok Online, pets give stat bonuses only at higher intimacy (Cordial/Loyal); intimacy rises with feeding and falls with neglect or overfeeding. In World//Zero, pets have one ability (damage, heal or status), level up from candy XP, and carry perks.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Use a bond ('정') that grows by hunting together and unlocks the bonus at bond 2 and 3. Skip RO's decay and starvation, since punishment and chores do not suit kids and AGENTS says no stress mechanics. Keep one small ability per pet.

findings.topic: Good/evil skill variants (inFAMOUS karma)
findings.what: In inFAMOUS, each power has good and evil upgrades unlocked by karma rank. Good versions are precise and defensive; evil versions are stronger and destructive. In Second Son, the paired perks are 'Karmic Healing' (heal by sparing) vs 'Energy Drain' (heal by executing).
findings.takeaway_for_us: Each class skill has one base mechanic plus a faction twist that unlocks at rank 2 or 3 (Titles thresholds 10/50). Halo: allies healed or shielded. Horns: drain or bigger hit with a self-cost. Neutral (no rank): utility such as gathering monsters or an extra material roll. The class-skill system then expresses 'every action tilts angel or devil' without new PvP power.

findings.topic: Roblox paid random items policy (eggs and gacha later)
findings.what: 'Paid random items' covers items bought with Robux or with in-game currency bought with Robux. Odds must cover every outcome and sum to 100%. Items that change odds (luck boosts, pity) must be disclosed in numbers. Users with PolicyService ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted must get an alternative or not see the feature. Random rewards from unpaid actions need no odds.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Eggs bought only with earned gold (GDD v1.2) are not paid random items today, because gold is never sold. If a Robux-to-gold product or paid eggs ever appear (GDD §10-1), the gold eggs become paid random items too: odds UI, a PolicyService check and luck disclosure become mandatory. Recommend no luck or drop-rate pets at all: they would touch the 1/20000 jackpot and fall under disclosure rules.

findings.topic: Pet rendering and performance
findings.what: Forum guidance: drive pet following with AlignPosition and AlignOrientation, give network ownership to the client or render pets on the client, and react to attribute changes instead of polling every frame.
findings.takeaway_for_us: The server stores only the EquippedPet id and form as attributes, and each client builds pets for nearby players (Massless, CanCollide false, no Humanoid, low part count). This keeps us inside MaxParts 1600, the monster GlobalCap 72 and phone performance limits (Config.luau:823, :911; GDD §14).

findings.topic: Art constraint for pets and weapons
findings.what: No new visual style may be invented in code. Firefly art comes after gameplay with user approval. No more paid Tripo work for avatars, and new 3D monsters need Tripo cost approval. The 27 final 3D weapons are already a launch item; beta keeps the current weapons. The Slime 3D model is approved (redesign planned later).
findings.source: AGENTS.md (Latest user decisions, Art workflow); docs/RELEASE_PLAN.md:31-37, :49, :64; art/approved.json:30
findings.takeaway_for_us: For beta, the only zero-new-art pet would be a scaled-down approved Slime with the existing halo or horns pieces (user must approve the look). All other pets, weapon skins, enhancement glows (+4/+7/+10) and skill icons need Firefly concepts approved one by one. Design docs can list the art needed; code should wait.

findings.topic: Idea: crown shard as the first companion
findings.what: In S0 the shard 'watches you fight, then fights for you' (that is how auto combat unlocks), and the player then chooses Purify or Devour. A23-2 currently says the shard is quest state only, not an inventory item.
findings.takeaway_for_us: Optional (needs a user decision because it changes A23-2): show the shard as a small floating companion that turns golden or halo (Purify) or dark or horned (Devour) and visibly 'fights' when auto is ON. That would be the first pet with a story reason and a GDD §0 tilt, taught in the first 10 minutes. Its stats should stay zero; the cosmetic alone teaches the system.

findings.topic: Anti-farming for tilt and honor from new actions
findings.what: Minted rewards between the same two players already use PairReady cooldowns saved in PairCD (300 s for KOs, 1800 s for kaiju). Altar and rebirth rules prevent switching away from a faction to dodge bully penalties.
findings.takeaway_for_us: If Halo heal skills or pet bond give Honor, Infamy or pet tilt for helping other players, gate it with PairReady per helper and target, or two friends or alts could farm it by healing each other. Monster-based tilt (pet hunting with you) needs no pair gate.

findings.topic: Recommended phasing vs the 2026-10-24 freeze
findings.what: About 19 days remain before feature freeze (beta 10/31). The worker still owns the story-quest engine and S0, loot and scrolls, NPC shops, the HUD and multi-client tests. Launch 12/19: third skill, rank-gated faction twists, slot screen, T7 faction forge, 27 3D weapons, pet slot with 3-6 drop-egg pets, bond and angel/devil forms, PvE-only bonuses (move ≤ +10% outside PvP, MP regen, PvE damage ≤ +5%). design.system:
CLASS SKILLS (직업 스킬): each class (Warrior / Mage / Archer) gets 3 skills on the same keys for everyone (Q / Z / X; gamepad L2 / L1 / R1).
- Q is today's Config.BasicSkill. It is unchanged and free when the class is picked.
- Z is the class "signature" skill (대표 스킬), learned at Lv5.
- X is a utility skill, learned at Lv10.
- Z and X are learned for gold from a temporary default-Roblox "스킬 선생님" NPC in Crossroads (A23-6 pattern).
- A skill's button appears only after it is learned. There are no empty, locked or "next unlock" slots.
- All skills share the existing 100 MP pool (regen 4/s), fire in the facing direction, and run through ONE server executor. That executor keeps the current quest, auto and faction hooks.
- Auto combat casts learned skills in slot order, on monsters only.
- Faction changes only the name and colour and keeps the existing perks: Halo heals allies, Horns drains HP, Neutral gets neither.
- Job advancement (around Lv30) is a LATER item.
- Beta MVP = Q + Z only.
design.pitch_ko: 직업마다 스킬 3개(Q·Z·X)예요. 지금 쓰는 Q 스킬은 그대로 두고, Lv5에 Z, Lv10에 X를 교차로 '스킬 선생님'에게 골드로 배워요. 배운 스킬만 버튼이 생겨요(빈 칸·잠금 표시 없음). 스킬은 바라보는 방향으로 나가고, 자동 전투도 배운 스킬을 순서대로 써요(몬스터만). 직업마다 대표 스킬이 하나씩 있어요: 전사는 앞으로 길게 베기, 마법사는 한 마리를 아주 세게, 궁수는 일직선으로 꿰뚫기. 진영에 따라 이름과 색이 바뀌고, 빛은 동료 치유, 뿔은 체력 흡수가 그대로 붙어요. MP를 같이 나눠 써서 '무조건 세지는' 게 아니라 '골라 쓰는 재미'가 늘어요. 베타엔 Z까지, X는 정식, 전직은 나중이에요.

design.rules_numbers:
Grounded in the current Config values:
- MaxMana 100, ManaRegen 4/s, Mage swing 2 MP (Config.luau:22-25).
- BasicSkill: ManaCost 20, Cooldown 3, DamageMultiplier 6, Radius 9, PvPCapPct 0.35, HaloHealPct 0.10, HaloHealCapPct 0.30 (:333-336).
- Swing does 0.5×D.
- Class Damage: W 1.0, M 1.3, A 0.55. Range: W 10 / M 35 / A 30. AimCone: 75 / 80 / 80. Archer WalkSpeedMult 1.1 (:251-306).
- WeaponDamage = Damage × (1 + 0.02 × (Lv−1)) × (1 + 0.1 × enhance).

Skill damage formula: the same pipeline as Q today, D × Mult × class.ReleaseMult. D comes from ComputeMonsterHit(no crit), so there is no new bonus source.

Damage per MP per target, in units of D:
- Q 0.30
- Warrior Z 0.30
- Mage Z 0.36 (single-target premium)
- Archer Z 0.35 (aim premium)
- Mage X 0.12 plus a slow

Sustained MP limit: 4 MP/s, which is about one 20-25 MP skill every 5-6 s. New skills add CHOICE and early burst (a full bar is about Q+Z+Q+Z in about 6 s), not more sustained DPS.

Example hits, Lv5 with the T1 weapon (base 8.64):
- Warrior: Q 52, Z 65
- Mage: Q 67, Z 101
- Archer: Q 29, Z 33

Example hits, Lv10 with the T3 weapon (base 44.8):
- Warrior: Q 269, Z 336
- Mage: Q 350, Z 525
- Archer: Q 148, Z 173

Monster HP for reference: Slime 10, 왕 슬라임 40, Goblin 90, Brute 260, Skeleton 450, Knight 1300.

Cooldowns:
- Per slot (Q 3 / Z 5-6 / X 12-18).
- Shared SkillGap of 0.5 s between any two skills (readable animation, no same-frame stacking).
- A failed MP or target check never starts the cooldown (the current TrySpendMana rule).

Unlock pacing:
- Q at class pick.
- Z at Lv5: about 45 slimes, about 9-12 min (reference_lessons #10 / quest_chain timeline), the same moment as the A23-3 "Lv5 → 철 무기" line.
- X at Lv10: about 23-40 min, together with the opening of 고블린 숲.
- Later: advancement around Lv30.
- This matches the reference game's Lv10/20/30/40 cadence WITHOUT showing locked slots.

Prices (gold):
- Z costs 100. By Lv5 the player has about 350 earned: M0 150 + about 45 slimes × 3 + G1 36s. Even after the 150 wooden weapon it is affordable, and the 800 iron weapon stays the longer goal.
- X costs 400, close to the Lv10 chapter-end reward of 384.
- Paid through ProgressionService.SpendGold (pocket first, then bank).

Learning rules:
- MinLevel is checked ONLY when learning. A learned skill stays usable at any level.
- The class must match the current class.
- The player must be within 12 studs of the real NPC.
- Learning twice is rejected without charging.

PvP rules:
- Basic hit unchanged, about 5% of base MaxHP.
- Shared skill budget per (attacker → victim): 0.35 × the victim's MaxHealth, refilling linearly to full over 3 s (= BasicSkill.Cooldown). Active kaiju: 0.08 (Kaiju.ReleaseCapPct).
- Result: Q+Z+X can never exceed what Q alone already allows today, 35% per 3 s.
- Slow, pull and buff effects apply to monsters or self/allies only, never to enemy players.

GDD §0 ("every action tilts angel or devil") holds without new PvP power:

1. Same skill, two faces. Every damaging skill goes through the one shared post-hit pipeline:
   - Halo skills heal Halo allies inside the hit area: 10% of the HP actually removed, capped at 30% of each ally's MaxHP, so a whiff heals nothing.

   - Neutral gets a crafting twist only in phase 2.
6. Teacher lines use the faction voice ("지키는 칼" vs "빼앗는 칼").
7. Skill use itself gives NO Honor/Infamy (two friends could farm it by healing each other). The tilt keeps coming from story choices (S0 정화/삼킴, M2-3, M3-4) and PvP acts, with the PairReady gates.
design.balance_safety:
PvP and kaiju:
- A shared per-victim skill budget (35% of MaxHealth, refilling over 3 s; 8% on an Active kaiju) replaces the per-cast cap. Without it, Q+Z+X inside about 1 s would do about 105% and one-shot a player, breaking GDD §5-2.
- New skills NEVER feed GetDamageBonus / GetDamageMult, so the basic swing (about 5%), Size Justice and the bully PowerOf are untouched.
- CC (slow) and buffs never target enemy players.
- Enemy players are picked only through playersNear(), which calls CanAttack. That keeps rookies (Lv15 / 60 min), Neutral immunity, safe zones and spawn protection intact.
- BreakProtection runs after any player hit. Multi-tick effects re-check CanAttack on each tick.

Auto combat (A23-1):
- isAuto casts skip players.
- They do not MarkActive.
- They do not count toward SkillHit quests or goose / kaiju credit.
- They cast only with a monster in the shape, so no MP is wasted in town.

Exploits:
- The server owns Learned, price, cooldown and MP.
- UseSkill rejects unlearned slots and skills of another class.
- "Release" stays the Q alias through the same checks, so it is not a back door.
- Learning is idempotent: a double click charges once, with no yield between SpendGold and the write.
- A dead player, a far player or a missing NPC is rejected.

Speed (launch): capped at ×1.35 and applied only on the server. A client-set WalkSpeed would trip the CR-H2 move check. The speed buff is off while carrying a sack, at 3+ wanted stars or as the kaiju, so a 45 s sack escape cannot be gamed. No dash or blink skills (no teleport grace needed).

Kid safety: names without blood ("체력 흡수", "그림자 늪", not 흡혈 or 저주); no stun-locking players; no griefing tools.

Monetization: skills, skill books and upgrades are never sold for Robux; no gacha; only change tickets stay on sale (GDD §10).

Tuning watch (measure, do not change without the user):
- Mage MP starvation: the swing costs 2 MP / 1.1 s, so net regen is about 2.2/s while swinging.
- Archer skills are weak per hit because class Damage 0.55 applies; the Classes.Archer.ReleaseMult knob exists.
- Early game is already skill-heavy (a skill is 12 times a swing). Time the first 10-15 minutes with and without Z: kills per minute, Lv5 time.

problems.issue: Line skills will often miss, in manual and in auto. Server hits are judged from root.CFrame.LookVector (CombatService.inAim :297-303), but the client turn has three gaps. (1) L.FaceTarget (HUD.luau:2730-2757) returns false WITHOUT turning when any monster is already inside the 75-80 degree cone (:2749). (2) It searches monsters only, within class Range (Warrior 10), not the skill Length. (3) The turn is a client CFrame write followed by fire() 0.08 s later, and physics replication is not ordered with RemoteEvents. Archer Z (40 long x 5 wide) tolerates only about +/-3.6 degrees at the far end, and Warrior Z (18 x 8) about +/-12 degrees. The auto-face loop (HUD.luau:3243-3251) only calls the same FaceTarget while the player stands still, so auto Z almost never lines up and the 'monster in the shape' gate quietly skips it.
problems.fix: Aim Line and Single skills on the server. Direction = flat vector from the root to the nearest aimed target within the class AimCone and the skill Length. Candidates are monsters, plus enemy players from playersNear() on manual casts. Fall back to LookVector only when there is no target. Use the same resolver in autoTick. This keeps UseSkill at zero extra args, which is what the design wants. On the client, add a FaceTarget(range, force) variant that always turns toward the target the server will pick (cosmetic only). Test: monster 30 degrees off-facing at 25 studs -> Archer Z hits; test under Studio's incoming-replication-lag setting at 150 ms.

problems.issue: The PvP budget claim is false as written. A token bucket (capacity 35%, refilling linearly over 3 s) lets the attacker deal about 35% + 11.7% x W of skill damage in any window of W seconds. Example: Q at t=0 then Z at t=2.9 removes about 69% of the victim's MaxHealth in 2.9 s. Today the most any window shorter than 3 s can see is 35%: BasicSkill.PvPCapPct 0.35 per cast, a 3 s cooldown and HitPctOfMaxHP 0.10, so Warrior/Mage Q is always capped. So 'Q+Z+X can never exceed what Q alone allows' does not hold, and the user question 'skill damage summed is at most 35% per 3 s' does not describe the bucket.
problems.fix: Use a sliding window instead. Keep a per (attacker -> victim) list of {t, amount}; allowed = capPct x victim MaxHealth - sum(amount where now - t < BasicSkill.Cooldown). capPct is 0.35, or Kaiju.ReleaseCapPct 0.08 while the victim is an Active kaiju. Prune old entries and clear on leave. Tests: Q@0 then Z@2.9 -> Z deals 0; Q@0 then Z@3.0 -> Z deals up to 35%; two attackers keep independent windows. This matches the user-facing sentence exactly and is easy to explain.
