problems.fix: Give each Z a visible job in the Lv5-10 band. Warrior: a longer, wider front strip (about 22x10) that nudges hit monsters toward the player, monsters only. Mage: a kid-friendly chain bolt (nearest aimed target, then 3-4 jumps within 10 studs, each x5-6), with single-target burst moved to X or job advancement. Archer pierce is fine. Add a measured check to the 15-minute timing: kills per minute and taps per kill with and without Z, and record the moment Z is first used.

problems.issue: Faction sustain doubles in PvP, and the heal area is undefined for the new shapes. Halo heal is per cast (10% of HP removed, capped at 30% of each ally's MaxHP, and it counts damage to monsters). Horns lifesteal is also per cast (capped at 3%). With Q+Z, a Halo mage farming goblins next to allies in Goblin Woods heals them about twice as fast, which tilts PvP toward Halo outside the damage budget. The existing heal loop selects allies by FlatDistance(ally, center) <= radius (CombatService.luau:956); a Single shape has no radius and a Line has no circle, so the heal either reaches almost no one or needs ad-hoc numbers.
problems.fix: Put heal and lifesteal on the same sliding window as damage. Halo: per ally, at most 30% MaxHP per 3 s from all skills. Horns: per caster, at most 3% MaxHP per 3 s from skills. Define one heal area for every shape: allies within BasicSkill.Radius (9) of the caster, plus the Line strip if desired. Add tests: Q+Z heal on the same ally within 3 s stays at or below 30%.

problems.issue: HUD double work. The design files the Z/X placement under the 'planned HUD redesign mockup (RELEASE_PLAN step 6)' as a LAUNCH item. Step 6 actually comes right after the gameplay steps and before beta. Retrofitting Z into the current hand-tuned layout (HUD.luau:3043-3111, ClusterTop/ClusterLeft) and then redoing it in the redesign doubles the phone-layout iteration at 749x361, which is already the most fragile part.
problems.fix: Add ONE layout anchor for the skill slots: HUD.Layout gains SkillSlots = {Z = pos, X = pos}, computed in one place from the attack and Q positions, so the redesign moves them as a group. Ask the user now to include a Z button (and a reserved X spot) in the step-6 mockup. Until then, keep Z visually identical to Q at the smaller size.

problems.issue: Too many user questions for the user's own rule. idea_backlog.md line 3 says sessions decide creative details (look, how it is obtained, abilities) and the user is asked only about money, PvP fairness, changes to existing rules and schedule. Q1 (how many skills), Q3 (learn method; GDD §0-1 and weapon decision #5 already say skills are sold at a shop NPC) and Q4 (which Z bundle) are creative or already decided.
problems.fix: Ask only four questions: schedule (beta Z or not, ranked against pets and monsters); the keys Z/X, because A23-10 says '스킬 키는 Q만'; PvP (new skills may hit players, 3 s / 35% shared window); and skills kept through rebirth and class change, which is new relative to GDD §9. Decide the rest internally and record it in docs/design.

problems.issue: The speed cap is not shared with the pet system from the same request. computeWalkSpeed caps class x skill-buff at x1.35, but pets are meant to add move speed too. With independent bonuses, Archer 1.1 x windstep 1.25 x pet bonus stacks past the cap and around the sack, 3-star and kaiju gates. Separately, ZoneService's move check reads the live hum.WalkSpeed (ZoneService.luau:157) with MoveMult 1.6 and Enforce=false, so there is no false-positive risk as long as only the server sets WalkSpeed.
problems.fix: Define one PlayerService.computeWalkSpeed(player) = Player.WalkSpeed x class x pet x buff, with ONE total cap (1.35) and one gate (SackGold > 0, WantedStars >= 3 and KaijuState Active strip all bonuses). Both the skill and pet designs call it. Never set WalkSpeed from the client.

problems.issue: Launch X skills have balance holes. Warrior guard (damage taken x0.7, Halo allies x0.85) changes the effective PvP rule '발사 한 방 = 최대 35%' and would make an Active kaiju (a Warrior who casts guard manually) much harder to raid. Mage slow sets the monster Humanoid WalkSpeed, but MonsterService already writes WalkSpeed at spawn (:784) and sets 0 at death/stagger (:960), so a naive restore can revive the movement of a dead or stunned monster.
problems.fix: Guard: no effect while KaijuState is Active; ally reduction only on the caster's own faction and never stacked (take the max of the multipliers). Slow: store rec.SlowMult with an expiry and compute WalkSpeed = def.Speed x SlowMult in the one place MonsterService already sets it, never restoring blindly.

problems.issue: Performance and noise from auto Z. Every auto Q and Z now goes to every player within 210+ studs via fxNear, and Warrior Z adds 3 dust bursts of about 45 particles. With many AFK auto players in Slime Meadow this doubles Fx remotes and particles on phones. reference_lessons #8 asks for quiet auto hits.
problems.fix: Auto casts send reduced Fx: no shake, at most about 15 particles per burst, and a smaller send radius (owner plus about 60 studs). Cap per-cast particle totals in the MOTION table. In the 3-client test, measure the FPS impact of auto Q+Z with 3 players auto-farming together.

problems.issue: Small gaps in the executor and UX. (1) onUseSkillRemote must update lastManualAt like onReleaseRemote (CombatService.luau:1182), or auto will cast over manual Z presses. (2) A Z press inside the 0.5 s SkillGap is silently dropped; on phones that feels broken. (3) A23-1 still says auto uses the '기본 스킬'. AGENTS 'Latest user decisions' already says 'skills', but the addendum text should be aligned so a reviewer does not flag auto-Z. (4) Q and Z share the same 'Release' animation clip, which ignores the user's 10/06 memo that attack motions feel monotonous.
problems.fix: Set lastManualAt in UseSkill. Grey out Z during the gap, or queue one press like MANUAL_GRACE. Update the A23-1 wording when the design is approved. Pick a distinct stock or existing clip for each Z.

problems.issue: Kid-safety tone. The Horns teacher line '세게 배워야 많이 털지!' has a teacher NPC endorsing robbing other players. It is in-theme, since the daily quest '빛의 기사단 %d명 털기' exists, but a teacher voice addressed to children is a different register.
problems.fix: Use a Horns-proud line that does not tell the player to rob, e.g. '세게 배워야 뿔 군단답지!'. Keep the robbing vocabulary in PvP quests only.

better_ideas: Server-side aiming for every directional skill. The server picks the nearest aimed target and builds the Line or Single from it, with LookVector as the fallback. This removes the dependence on client replication, makes auto Z work, and keeps UseSkill at zero extra args.

One sliding-window 'budget' module, shared for PvP skill damage (35% per 3 s per attacker -> victim; Active kaiju 8%), Halo heal per ally (30% per 3 s) and Horns skill lifesteal (3% per 3 s). It matches the user sentence exactly and covers any future pet or weapon procs.

Put GDD §0 into learning itself, at no PvP cost. At the teacher, a one-time choice '지키는 법' / '빼앗는 법' uses the existing StoryQuestService choice UI. It gives +1 Honor or Infamy (Neutral: recorded only), sets the cosmetic Fx tint now, and selects the rank-2 twist variant at launch. It happens once per skill, so it cannot be farmed.

Learning Z should be a story beat, not a pinned-line override. Add a short Lv5 sub-quest at the skill teacher: talk, learn, then 'Z로 한 번에 슬라임 2마리'. It shares one guidance thread with the quest chain, gives the first Z use a tutorial and a reward, and is easy to time in the 15-minute run.

Generalize ensurePotionMerchant into ensureShopNpc(def) and BUILDERS.PotionShop into a generic list-shop builder. The skill teacher, the future pet trainer NPC and any weapon or skill-book vendor then cost data, not code. This also reduces the risk of the 200-locals limit in Panels.

Pet Trainer (A23-13) reuses the existing combat shapes: its Q/Z are the Archer TargetAoE/Line, with the pet performing them visually. That delivers the user's pet-trainer idea without new combat code. Pets for everyone else stay passive (no extra phone button).
Ship Z dark behind Config.Skills Enabled flags with a 10/20 go/no-go. Code can merge early, and the freeze risk becomes a config flip instead of a rollback.

Use the weapon request for synergy without power creep. Legendary T8 (젤리 왕관) and faction T7 weapons change the colour or trail of Z's Fx (cosmetic only), so 'cooler weapons' visibly change how skills look.

One computeWalkSpeed shared by class, pet and skill buff, with a single 1.35 cap and the sack, 3-star and kaiju gates. Write it into both the skills and pet docs so the two designs cannot stack past it.

design.system:
Weapon Roster v2 "등급과 이야기가 있는 무기" (Graded, story-named weapon families). This change adds no new combat math. Every weapon is still one Damage number in Config.Weapons that flows through Config.WeaponDamage (Config.luau:229-232), so PvE kill speed, the PvP power ratio clamp of 0.8-1.5 (CombatService.luau:404-424) and Justice/bully PowerOf (Config.luau:515-517) all keep working unchanged.

Three things make weapons cooler and more numerous:
1. **Rarity grades.** Five grades use the colors already documented in ART_DIRECTION §2.3: 일반 200,200,200 / 고급 90,200,90 / 희귀 70,140,255 / 영웅 170,90,230 / 전설 255,160,40, and only 전설 gets the UIGradient shimmer. Each grade also shows a star count (★1-★5), so color is never the only cue.
2. **Story-named families.** Each data entry yields 3 class weapons (sword/staff/bow), so one new entry = 3 new weapons. Names follow the approved lore beats in quest_chain_2026-10-06.md decision 7: slimes ate crown dust → 젤리 왕관 / 말랑 방울; goblins stole the dust → 숲도둑; skeletons guarded the old kingdom's crown → 옛 왕국 / 수호령; someone calls the crown from the tomb → 잠든 왕. The top tier is the faction line 여명 / 파멸 / 왕관 조각.
3. **Status moments.** Server-wide brag announcements fire for 영웅+ drops and for +10 enhancement. Optional enhancement glow at +4/+7/+10 reuses the existing addLight/sparkle helpers.

How weapons are obtained (GDD §0-1):
- 일반 and 고급 basics come from the blacksmith shop for gold.
- 희귀 and 영웅 come from monster drops, plus a bad-luck guarantee: a pity counter at 1.5x the expected kills.
- 전설 comes from the slime jackpot (luck only, unchanged) or, at launch, from crafting the faction weapon at the Neutral artisan with Skeleton King materials plus faction rank 3.

Enhancement stays exactly A23-11/12 for every grade: max +10, +10% per level, failure means a 50% chance of -1 and never destruction, and transfer scrolls add the full +N. A useful ladder property: +10 on any tier stays just below the next tier at +0 (T3+10 = 76 < T4 88; T4+10 = 176 < T5 200; T5+10 = 400 < T6 450; T6+10 = 900 < T7 1000). Enhancing is therefore never wasted (transfer it) and never skips the chase.

Save safety rules:
- Config.Weapons is append-only. Indices 1-8 are frozen because WeaponOwnedMask bits and WeaponEnhance slots are index-keyed.
- New fields Grade/Source/Family/Look replace every 'tier number' assumption: staff tip size, light and sparkle thresholds, contiguous shop sales, '>= 3' iron checks, and sort order.

All base values come from Config.luau; new values are marked (NEW, provisional). A23-12 lets the work session set drop rates and tune them after measuring.

DAMAGE LADDER (Config.Weapons :167-181). Formula: WeaponDamage = Damage × (1 + 0.02 × (Lv-1)) × (1 + 0.1 × enh) (:229-232). A Warrior basic hit adds × class 1.0 × SwingImmediate 0.5. Monster HP: Slime 10, BigSlime 40, Goblin 90, Brute 260, Skeleton 450, Knight 1300.
| Tier | Damage | Use point | Hit size | Hits to kill |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | 8 | Lv1 | 4 | slime 3 |
| T2 | 15 | Lv1 | 7.5 | slime 2 |
| #9 (NEW) | 24 | Lv1 | 12 | slime 1, BigSlime 4 |
| T3 | 38 | Lv5 | 20.5 | slime 1, goblin 5 |
| T8 | 90 | Lv10 | 53 | goblin 2, brute 5 |
| T4 | 88 | Lv12 | 53.7 | goblin 2, brute 5 |
| T5 | 200 | Lv20 | 138 | skeleton 4, knight 10 |
| T6 | 450 | Lv30 | 355 | skeleton 2, knight 4 |
| #10 (NEW) | 600 | Lv35 | 504 | knight 3 |
| T7 | 1000 | Lv40 | 890 | knight 2 |

Note on T8: A23-12 says '≈2x T3' and 90 is 2.37x, the same as T4. Keep 90 unless the user wants exactly 76.

ENHANCEMENT (A23-11/12, unchanged, all grades):
- MaxEnhance 10, +10% per level, so +10 = x2.
- Enh70/30/10 give +1/+2/+3. A failure has a 50% chance of -1 (never below +0) and never destroys the weapon.
- Move70/30/10 transfer scrolls ADD the full +N (capped at 10); a failure keeps both weapons as they were.
- Stored per index and kept through rebirth.
- +10 is always below the next tier at +0: 76<88, 176<200, 400<450, 900<1000.

SHOP:
- Config.WeaponShop.Tiers = {2,3} (NEW explicit list). Prices are 150 / 800; selling pays floor(price × 0.1) = 15 / 80.
- Drop, craft and jackpot weapons are never sold for gold; a duplicate converts to gold.
- DuplicateWeaponGold (:1393): existing [4]=300, [5]=1000, [6]=3000, [7]=9000, [8]=3000. NEW: [9]=100, [10]=6000, [11]=1500.

DROPS (Loot.Tables :1346-1387) are unchanged for beta; golden monsters x3 (:1323).

PITY (NEW):
- At = 1.5 expected drops, i.e. the sum of P × golden mult while the weapon is not owned.
- Worst case to the guarantee:
  - T4: 1,500 goblins or 300 brutes
  - T5: 3,000 skeletons or 500 knights
  - T6: 3,000 knights (launch boss: 30 kills)
  - #9: 150 BigSlimes
  - #10: 19 boss kills
- Estimate: leveling Lv10-25 in Goblin Woods is about 800 goblins and 100 brutes, so about 1.3 expected T4 drops, about a 73% natural chance; pity catches the rest.
- The jackpot T8 has no pity.

ANNOUNCE (NEW):
- MinGrade 4 for drops; the forge always announces; +10 announces once per weapon per player.
- Server queue of 1 per 20 s; viewers with TutorialStep < 99 skip it.

GRADE VISUALS:
- Today's look is preserved as Grade >= 4 → PointLight (range 10, brightness 2) and Grade 5 → sparkle (rate 12, size 0.35).
- OPTIONAL enhancement glow (after approval), using only the weapon's own Config.WeaponColor:
  - +4: light range 6, brightness 1
  - +7: light range 9, brightness 1.8, plus sparkle rate 5, size 0.25
  - +10: light range 12, brightness 2.5, plus sparkle rate 14, size 0.35
- No Highlight instances (31-per-client limit).

PVP:
- A weapon only moves ratio = clamp(attacker WeaponDamage / victim WeaponDamage, 0.8, 1.5) (Config.PvP :559-560).
- A basic hit stays at about 5% × at most 1.5. The skill stays capped at 35% (BasicSkill.PvPCapPct :335).
- No weapon traits.

LAUNCH FORGE (NEW):
- 왕관의 심장 x3, KnightCrest x20, Bone x50 and 30,000 gold.
- Halo/Horns need rank 3 (Honor/Infamy >= 50, Titles :475); Neutral needs 왕관의 심장 x4 and no rank.
- Equipping needs current rank >= 3 (Halo/Horns).

LAUNCH BOSS (NEW), per contributor with >= 1% damage: 왕관의 심장 30%, 잠든 왕 8%, T6 5%.

design.good_evil_hook:
1. The top weapon is earned by deeds. The T7 faction weapon needs faction rank 3: Honor 50 for Halo (성기사) or Infamy 50 for Horns (군벌) (Config.Titles :474-478). Your strongest sword literally comes from how angelic or devilish you played (GDD §0, '선택이 곧 편').
2. The weapon follows its owner's heart. Equipping T7 requires your current rank. After a free altar switch zeroes your score, the weapon changes to the new side's look (여명 → 파멸, existing WeaponName/FactionColors) but stays unusable until you earn rank 3 on the new side. Switching sides is visible on your hands.
3. The look shows the alignment. 여명 glows gold and 파멸 glows red: the server builds the model, so every player sees it, and the existing light and sparkle are tinted with the faction color. The launch forge announcement carries the faction name: '빛의 기사단 OO님이 [여명의 검]을 완성했어요!'.
4. The forge moment echoes S0. A one-line text choice frames it: Halo '조각을 정화해 빛을 담는다', Horns '조각의 힘을 삼킨다'. It gives a one-time +5 Honor or Infamy and cannot be farmed because it happens once per weapon.
5. Neutral's third path: the 장인 길드 crafts its own 왕관 조각 line with extra materials instead of a rank. This gives the guild's promised '제작 특화' (GDD §5-8) its first real content, with no combat buff.
6. The names tell the crown story the player is already living:
   - 젤리 왕관 and 말랑 방울: slimes ate crown dust.
   - 숲도둑: goblins stole it.
   - 옛 왕국 and 수호령: knights who guarded the crown.
   - 잠든 왕: the voice calling from the tomb.
   Every chase weapon is a piece of the main quest line.
design.balance_safety:
PvP: power stays a single Damage number, so PvP only sees ratio = clamp(…, 0.8, 1.5) (CombatService :413-418). The jackpot or a +10 weapon cannot exceed 1.5x. The skill cap of 35% and the kaiju cap of 8% are untouched.
- No weapon traits in beta or launch. Any later trait must be PvE-only inside ComputeMonsterHit.
- Separate note: the research found the basic swing has no final hard clamp; other bonuses can stack to about 22%. Recommend a hard swing cap before adding more bonus sources (outside the weapon scope).
- Justice/bully PowerOf uses Damage by index, so new entries just need correct Damage.

No destruction: scroll failure is -1 at most, transfer failure keeps both weapons, there is no new failure type, drop weapons are never sellable, and duplicates convert to gold.

No monetization: no Robux weapons. Paid boxes are a documented later plan only (GDD §10-1, odds plus PolicyService).
- Pity and drops are free actions, so no disclosure is legally needed, but the pity gauge is shown anyway (honest for kids).
- The jackpot keeps pure luck, as the user decided in A23-12 (auto kills included).

Anti-grind: pity caps any rare chase at 1.5x the expected kills. A 영웅 chase also gets a boss path at launch.

Save safety:
- Append-only indices.
- Mask band instead of reset, and enhancement slots preserved, both for rollback.
- String-keyed LootPity.
- 32-id bit ceiling; launch uses 11.

Announcement spam:
- Grade >= 4 only.
- +10 once per weapon.
- 20 s server queue.
- Suppressed during onboarding (reference lessons #4).

Kid safety:
- No gore or blood words.
- Horns art is mischievous, not scary.
- Every Firefly image passes the modest/kid-safe review before upload (Hard rule 1).

No pre-announcing: T7, the boss, craft and event weapons stay hidden until their source exists (GDD §0-1, persona rule).

Performance:
- No Highlight.
- At most 1 PointLight and 1 ParticleEmitter per weapon; 20 players means 40 instances.
- Glow is gated behind a flag until approved.

Luau: HUD and Fx are near the 200-local limit, so put constants in the existing tables.

problems.issue: Two touchpoints are missing. Fx.luau:1788 compares tier indices and reads MaxSoldTier: `t > tier and t <= Config.WeaponShop.MaxSoldTier`. With #9 equipped (index 9, Damage 24), the Lv5 iron-weapon unlock announce silently disappears even though iron (38) is stronger. LootService.luau:383 (DebugReset) also resets the mask on any bit above max.
problems.fix: Route Fx:1788 through Config.WeaponIsShop and Config.WeaponAtLeast. Add a grep-style offline test that fails on any WeaponTier or tier comparison outside the new helpers (it currently hits Fx:1788 and CharacterVisuals:549/558/466).

problems.issue: The appended #10/#11 stubs marked Enabled=false are unsafe. Nothing reads Enabled: LootService validTier/owns/onEquipWeapon (55-63, 286-306), sanitize, Panels and CharacterVisuals all ignore it. The stubs also have no Color/Material/Length, and buildSword/buildStaff do arithmetic on w.Length (CharacterVisuals:446, 454), so any grant path (debug, a DataStore edit, a rollback) breaks the weapon build. They also raise MaxWeaponTier for no benefit.
problems.fix: Do not append #10/#11 until their source ships (append-only allows adding them later). If stubs stay, the Config invariant test must require Color/Material/Length/Grade/Source on every entry, and grant/equip must reject Enabled==false on the server.

problems.issue: The claim 'Justice/bully keep working unchanged' hides a gap the design makes worse. Config.PowerOf (Config.luau:515-517) calls WeaponDamage(tier, level) without the enhancement, and JusticeService.levelAndTier (:178-182) reads only the tier. problems.fix: Pass WeaponEnhance into PowerOf from GetPower/GetCombatPower and the PvPService:200-210 fallback before shipping +10 announcements. Add a test: a +10 T3 attacker against a +0 T2 victim triggers the weak-victim rule.

problems.issue: Locking T7 equip to the current rank causes four problems. (1) Honor and Infamy come almost only from PvP KOs (PvPService:552/570/585/784; story and goose give +1-2, and quest_chain decision 3 budgets about 10 points in the first hour), so rank 3 (50) means roughly 40+ KOs. That pushes KO trading between friends or alts, and lowbie hunting for Horns. (2) The Robux faction ticket keeps the old side's score (FactionService:343-359), so switching back with a ticket keeps T7 usable while a free switch locks it. Robux would then protect access to the strongest weapon, against the spirit of GDD §10's no-stat-sales rule. (3) It discourages the faction switching that Size Justice and SignOnGold depend on. (4) There is no FactionService hook to force-unequip; CombatService reads WeaponTier raw.
problems.fix: Check rank only at craft time, never at equip; after a switch, only the faction look changes. Also count story choices, goose firsts and war contribution toward rank, and state the expected KO count in user decision 4. If an equip lock is kept anyway, add FactionService.SetFaction → force re-equip and test that the ticket and free paths behave the same.

problems.issue: #9 말랑 방울 on BigSlime gives veterans a reason to camp the beginner meadow. problems.issue: The pitch overclaims. better_ideas: Text-only weapon collection count '무기 도감 n/21' in the item list. It counts only weapons whose source is live and adds slots as each source ships. That makes 'many weapons' visible in beta at zero art cost without pre-announcing anything.

Nothing is sold, traded or lost.

design.later:
LATER (unscheduled; documented only)

Pets and content:
- Neutral guild crafted pet 태엽 딱정벌레, made from monster materials, when phase-2 crafting lands (GDD §5-8).
- Legendary 왕관 젤리 from the Skeleton King boss: first-clear quest or 1% drop. Moves to launch if the boss ships on time.

  - MoveSpeed: 6 / 8 / 10 / 12 / 15 %. Hard cap on the pet speed sum is +15%.
  - MonsterDamage: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 8 %. Cap 8%. For scale, the Horns faction gives +15%.
  - MonsterGold: 5 / 6 / 8 / 10 / 12 %. Cap 12%. For scale, Horns +25% and rebirth +25% each.

  - MPRegen: 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 % of ManaRegen 4/s. At most 5.2 MP/s, so the 20-MP skill can come every 3.85 s instead of every 5 s; the cooldown is 3 s.

- Stars and the evolution form never add power.

Speed (the user's headline ask):
- WalkSpeed = Config.Player.WalkSpeed 20 x class WalkSpeedMult (Archer 1.1) x (1 + min(petSpeed, 0.15)). Server only.
  - BabySlime Lv1 gives 21.4 (Archer 23.5); Lv10 gives 22.0 (Archer 24.2).

Pet XP:
- Kills to the next level = 15 x level. Lv10 is the max and needs 675 kills total.
- A golden kill counts 3, an auto kill counts 1, a personal or tutorial monster counts 0.
- XP is kept when the pet is unequipped.

Monster gold and XP bonus:
- extra = info.Gold (or info.XP) x existing mult x petPct.
- The fractional part is carried per session so small bonuses still pay. Otherwise floor(x + 0.5) on Slime's 3 gold would erase +12%.

design.balance_safety:
PvP caps:
- No pet value ever enters GetDamageBonus (CombatService:360), GetDamageMult (:375), ComputePvPHit (:404) or Config.PowerOf (:515).
- So the basic hit (about 5% of base HP), the 35% skill cap and the 8% kaiju cap are unchanged, and Size Justice and the bully rule need no change.
- MonsterDamage applies in ComputeMonsterHit only. A side effect is a slightly larger Halo heal (10% of damage, capped at 30% MaxHP) and Horns lifesteal (capped at 3% per hit) against monsters only. That is acceptable.
- No attack-speed pets: nextSwingAt (CombatService:660) is shared by PvP and goose counting.
- Speed and MP regen pause in PvP states (decision 2).

Economy:
- Pet buffs are small next to the faction bonuses (Halo XP +30%, Horns gold +25% and damage +15%) and rebirth +25% each.
- Gold and XP bonuses apply to monster kills only.
- Eggs are gold sinks.
- No luck or drop pets: the 1/20000 jackpot, the scroll rates and the 4% golden monster chance are untouched. The golden hatch is cosmetic.

AFK:
- No HP-regen or auto-potion pets, so auto combat plus a pet can't become immortal farming.
- Pet XP from auto kills is fine: the player is in the zone and visible.

Anti-cheat:
- WalkSpeed is set on the server only, so checkMove's MoveMult 1.6 and Slack 8 margin stays about 3x above the real move.
- RefreshSpeed fires on every gate change.
- No dash or blink.
- Verify the JusticeService ScaleTo/WalkSpeed interaction in Studio.

No loss and no stress:
- Pets are never consumed, destroyed, starved, decayed or failed.
- They are kept through death, rebirth and faction or class switch.
- Duplicates always give a benefit (★, level, then gold).
- No real-time hatch timers.

No trading:
- Pets are account-bound with no gift (A23-12 bans 1:1 trading). This removes scams, off-platform resale and stranger pressure.
- Adoption (backlog #27) needs the user's OK later.

Monetization:
- Nothing sold now. The odds are shown anyway.
- The future paid-egg checklist goes into GDD §10-1 (see later).

Kid safety:
- Cute designs only; modest-art workflow; no gore or fangs.
- Names: preset list by default; custom names go through the A21 filter and only broadcast-filtered text is shown.
- No FOMO eggs and no purchase prompts after losses.

Performance:
- No pet instances on the server; only attributes are replicated.
- Clients use anchored clones with CanCollide, CanQuery and CanTouch off (camera and raycasts ignore them, monsters can't target them).
- At most 20 pets (beta) or 40 (launch) at 20 players; render distance 120 studs; 15 Hz updates for others and 5 Hz beyond 60 studs.
- Target at most about 10 parts per pet, inside MaxParts 1600 and the monster GlobalCap 72 budget.
- A phone toggle hides others' pets.

Neutral:
- Pets apply to Neutral like weapons (decision 3). Neutral is PvP-immune, so there is no fairness impact.

problems.issue: The design conflicts with A23-13, which the user confirmed on 2026-10-05 around 17:00. A23-13 puts pets on the auction house later (after the anti-fraud and alt-account checks) and lets 펫 훈련사 send pets they designed to other players for gold, under the auction rules (docs/SPEC_ADDENDUM.md:91-106; idea_backlog #27 is marked '사용자 확정'). Against that, the design says "Nothing is sold, traded", the Korean pitch tells the user "사고팔지 않아요", it calls IsPaidItemTradingAllowed "moot because pets never trade", and it says adoption "needs the user's OK", although that OK was already given. The data model `Owned[speciesId]` keeps one record per species and folds duplicates into stars, so it cannot hold an individual pet that can be traded or a pet a trainer designed. Beta saves are live in DataStore and carry into launch, so changing this later means migrating saves.
problems.fix: Change the pitch line to '지금은 사고팔 수 없어요 (경매장·입양은 정식 이후, A23-13)'. Make the save instance-based now: `Pets.List[uid] = {Sp, Lv, XP, Golden, Name, Bound, Design?}`, `Pets.Stars[speciesId]`, `Equipped = {uid}`. Quest pets such as BabySlime get `Bound = true` (never tradeable). Put the IsPaidItemTradingAllowed check back into the paid-egg checklist.

problems.issue: Decision 4 option A contradicts A23-13. A23-13 says the hunter (사냥꾼) is removed and replaced by 펫 훈련사, every existing hunter gets a FREE class change, and how the trainer fights and which skills it has are still to be designed. Option A instead converts hunters automatically and gives the class only 'pet XP x2' plus the unchanged archer attack. It leaves out the free change, so a hunter who does not want the new class has two exits: reset to Lv1, or buy the Robux class ticket (GDD §10). That creates pressure to pay. It also ignores the user's same-message request for class-specific skills: a renamed archer with a growth perk is a weak class identity.
problems.fix: Option A must grant every existing Neutral archer a one-time free class-change token that keeps their level, at migration time. Hand 펫 훈련사 to the parallel class-skill design so it gets a pet-themed skill that only hits monsters, for example the pet hops to the nearest monster and the skill's area centres on it. Neutral players cannot be attacked in PvP, so the 35% skill cap and the basic-hit cap are not affected. Tell the user plainly that this is a new class identity, not just a new name.

problems.issue: Decision 2's default A (speed off whenever ZonePvP is true) makes the main feature disappear exactly where players spend Lv10 and up. GoblinWoods (Lv10+) and SkeletonRuins (Lv25+) are the only hunting zones from Lv10 on, and both have PvP = true (Config.luau:774-777). The gate also switches the pet off for Neutral players, who cannot be attacked (GDD §5-8), and for rookies below Lv15, whom nobody can attack (PvPService.CanAttack:416). Neither group raises a fairness issue. The user asked for '전투·이동 속도'; a pet that 'rests' in every zone after the first 30 minutes will feel broken.
problems.fix: Gate each player by whether they can actually be hit, not by zone. Pause the pet speed only when InCombatUntil > now, SackGold > 0, KaijuState ≠ None or wanted stars ≥ 3 (option B). Inside a PvP zone, also limit pet speed to the free quest pet's value (+7 to 10%), so a rare egg never decides a chase. Neutral players and rookies always get the full speed.

problems.issue: The speed-refresh triggers miss two of the gate's own conditions. InCombatUntil is a timestamp (CombatService.luau:450, CombatTagTime 15), and nothing fires when it runs out, so an attribute listener never sees the tag expire. SackGold changes (GrudgeService:105-109) are not in the refresh list at all. As written, pet speed either stays off after one PvP hit until the next zone change, or never turns off. There is also a second problem: RefreshSpeed writes an absolute WalkSpeed. The parallel class-skill design will probably add dashes and slows, and the pet refresh would overwrite them.
problems.fix: Add a 1 Hz gate check for each player in PetService, or schedule `task.delay(CombatTagTime + 0.1)` on every InCombatUntil change. Listen for SackGold and KaijuState attribute changes. Put the pet percentage inside PlayerService.applyStats (PlayerService.luau:116-130), so the existing RefreshCharacter callers (Justice:310, Kaiju:356/401/569, ClassService, Main:100-103) keep it. Make that one function the only place that sets speed, combining a `SpeedMods[player][source]` table that skills can share.

problems.issue: P1 might never show on screen. StoryQuestService.SubRows (StoryQuestService.luau:413-437) sends at most MaxSubs = 2 sub rows, ranked claimable > situational > S0 > others. At M1_4 (about 11 minutes), S3 (which requires M1_4), S4 (after S0) and N1 all sit in the same rank 3 as P1, and table.sort is not stable. The cute hook can therefore stay hidden for many minutes.
problems.fix: Give P1 rank 2, like S0, until it is accepted, or show it once through the existing next-goal line or a toast. A better option: open P1 after M1_1 (about 5 minutes), so the pet lands inside the 10-minute first milestone the AGENTS persona tests.

problems.issue: The pet can be lost if the grant fails. complete() saves st.Done[id] before it runs the Unlock branch (StoryQuestService.luau:194-208). If PetService.Grant throws inside the pcall, P1 is marked Done and BabySlime is gone for good. No catch-up check exists today, not even for S0/AutoCombat. That breaks the 'never lost' promise.
problems.fix: On DataLoaded in PetService: if Story.Done.P1 is set and BabySlime is not owned, grant it. Grant is idempotent, so this is safe. Apply the same pattern to S0 → AutoCombatUnlocked.

problems.issue: Several claims about reusing the slime model are wrong. Fx WOBBLE (Fx.luau:1045-1106) only animates models inside workspace.Monsters that have a VisualJoint weld, and it stops anchored roots. An anchored pet clone therefore gets no wobble and no 'depth = width' fix, so it shows the thin 3.1 x 2.1 side profile the user complained about. The offset (2.5, 0, 3) from the HumanoidRootPart puts the slime at hip height, because nothing places it on the ground. The offset also ignores the VisualScale attribute (up to 3.0, Justice MaxVisualScale), so the pet ends up inside large players. The pet would also look exactly like the hostile '조각먹은 슬라임' being killed next to it, which will confuse kids. Finally, the design has no fallback if CustomModels.Slime is missing or replaced: the slime 3D redesign is already queued, and BigSlime is still missing on the new account.
problems.fix: In PetFollow: apply the same depth fix and a hop/squash (copy the WOBBLE maths into a small shared module, without adding locals to Fx/HUD). Place the pet on the ground using HipHeight plus a downward raycast at 15 Hz. Multiply the offset by VisualScale. Add a text name label such as '아기 슬라임 · 친구' through the existing UIKit text. If the model is missing, fall back to the procedural slime body.

problems.issue: Pet XP would be broadcast on every kill. PetsJson carries XP and changes on every kill. Player attributes replicate to every client, and adding PetsJson to ITEMS.Attrs makes an open Items panel queueRebuild on every kill (Panels.luau:2569), which resets the scroll position on phones, especially while auto combat runs. The project already moved QuestsJson off attributes for this reason (Net.luau, CR-L50).
problems.fix: Keep only EquippedPet, PetLv, PetForm and PetGolden as attributes; other clients need these to draw the pet. Send the owner's pet list through an owner-only remote, only when it changes or the pet levels up. Update the XP text in place instead of rebuilding the panel.

problems.issue: The duplicate-to-gold rule inflates the economy. After 5★, a duplicate pays 30% of the nest price, and this also applies to free drop eggs. A Ruins duplicate pays 7,500G. At about one egg per 250 kills (about 21 minutes at 12 kills/min), that is roughly 350G/min, about +45% on top of the Ruins HuntValue of 780G/min. That income is far larger than any pet stat (cap 12%) and works against the 'eggs are gold sinks' claim.
problems.fix: Only nest-bought eggs refund 30% of the price actually paid. Duplicates from drop eggs convert to materials, pet treats or a small fixed gold amount (≤ 2 minutes of HuntValue), or are capped per day.

problems.issue: The gold-egg nest with odds is a gacha (뽑기). AGENTS 'Latest user decisions' (2026-10-05) says 'Gacha and other cash items ... documented only. Do not build products, code or screens for them now.' GDD v1.2 listed gold eggs, but the newer decision puts 뽑기 under 'later'. A random-odds nest also builds exactly the infrastructure a paid gacha would plug into.
problems.fix: Ask the user explicitly before planning a random nest for launch. The safer default is a nest that sells chosen species at fixed gold prices, with no odds. Keep randomness only in monster-drop eggs, which work like scroll drops.

problems.issue: The schedule math does not hold up. The proposed cuts (S9 → S6) are data-only rows worth hours, not the 3 days the pet needs, and S5 was already deleted by the user (HANDOFF_CODEX top section). Still open for the beta: R15/R6 checks after the costume removal, the potion NPC, HUD finish and phone layout, nickname persistence, monster restoration (BigSlime), English, and launch prep. The RELEASE_PLAN work order also puts the Firefly redraw and the full HUD redesign right after the gameplay steps, the user wants Halloween monsters, and the class-skill and weapon requests come from the same message. With apply-to-Studio, 3 clients, phone and DataStore checks, 3 days is optimistic; 4 to 5 is more realistic.
problems.fix: Give the user one combined decision covering skills, weapons and pets, naming what gets pushed back (for example English → launch, or a smaller HUD redesign). Shrink the pet MVP to about 2 days: auto-equip plus a show/hide toggle instead of equip rows, pet Lv1-5, and one text line in the Items panel.

problems.issue: MonsterDamage is not gated, but its PvP side effect is understated. In a PvP zone, the Halo skill's ally heal (10% of damage, capped at 30% MaxHP) and Horns lifesteal both grow with monster damage while a player fight is going on. Speed, damage and MP pets also raise kills per minute, auto kills included, which means more 1/20000 jackpot rolls and more pet XP while away. 'No pet changes the Jackpot' is true only in the narrow sense. MPRegen mainly helps the Mage, whose basic attack costs 2 MP every 1.1 s (A23-12), so in practice it is a Mage damage pet.
problems.fix: Turn MonsterDamage off while InCombatUntil > now. Describe the indirect effects honestly in the design. Keep MPRegen at or below 20% and check Mage kills per minute with and without it.

problems.issue: The toasts and the Korean choice wording could be better. '펫 속도 다시 켜짐!' would fire on every Outskirts ↔ GoblinWoods crossing with no throttle, on top of the existing EnteredPvP toasts, which clutters the phone screen. '길들여요' does not read as the devil side, and the Neutral A/B picks have no lean seed.
problems.fix: Merge the pet line into the existing PvP-entry toast and throttle both directions. Make the Horns-side option clearly mischievous, for example '내 졸개로 삼아요'. Neutral A/B gives a Balance seed of +2.

better_ideas: Make GDD §0 visible in the beta with no new art: the pet's text name label shows the P1 choice, e.g. '아기 슬라임 · 착한 친구' or '아기 슬라임 · 장난꾸러기 졸개'. From the beta on, record the owner's Light/Dark lean as data only, so the launch evolution already has history behind it.

Make PvP fair by equalising instead of switching off: while a player can be hit, every pet's speed becomes the free quest pet's value. Everyone can earn that pet, so the pet never 'stops working' and egg rarity never decides a chase.

Use one speed authority: PlayerService.applyStats combines `SpeedMods[player][source]` from the class, pet and class skills (dash, slow), so the pet and the parallel skill design never overwrite each other's WalkSpeed. It reuses the existing RefreshCharacter callers.
Store pets per instance (uid) and add a `Bound` flag now. The beta then needs no save migration when A23-13 auction listing or trainer adoption arrives, and quest pets stay account-bound.

Make 펫 훈련사 a real class through the class-skill workflow: a monster-only pet skill (the pet hops to a target and the skill area centres on it, or the pet keeps an enemy in place). Neutral players cannot be attacked, so no PvP cap is touched. Existing hunters get one free class change that keeps their level (A23-13).

Place the pet inside the first 10 minutes: open P1 after M1_1 and give it rank 2 in SubRows, so the cute hook lands inside the first-10-minute milestone the persona tests instead of at about 11 minutes, where it competes with S3, S4 and N1.

Let the launch nest sell chosen species at fixed gold prices, with no odds and no gacha decision needed. Keep the surprise in monster-drop eggs, and give faction eggs as rank trophies, which the design already guarantees by species.

Grow the pet through §0 actions as well as kills, e.g. +5 pet XP when a Halo skill heals an ally, or when a Horns player's grudge sack is paid out ('Paid'). The signals already exist (Released.Healed, SackResolved), so this grows the pet through good/evil play rather than AFK auto kills.
